jobs.title: Økonomimedarbeider
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å bruke din erfaring og kompetanse til å løse et viktig samfunnsoppdrag? Da er stillingen som økonomimedarbeider i Mottak- og returprosessen i UDI den rette stillingen for deg. Vi er en beredskapsorganisasjon, og det som skjer i verden, påvirker oppgavene og prioriteringene våre i stor grad. Migrasjonssvigningene har direkte effekt på arbeid i tjenesteområdet Mottak og retur ved at vi har ansvaret for innkvartering av asylsøkere og vi har nå et behov for å ansette en medarbeider i midlertidig stilling ut 2027. Som økonomimedarbeider i Mottak- og returprosessen vil du følge opp at våre samarbeidspartnere og kontraktspartnere får utbetalt det de har krav på til riktig tid. Det innebærer at du skal utføre bilagskontroll og attestasjon av fakturaer, utbetaling av tilskudd og økonomiske ytelser.  Teamet du blir en del av er ett tverrfagligteam på 19 medarbeidere, der hovedvekten av teammedlemmene har en økonomifaglig bakgrunn. Vi i teamet er fra alle UDIs lokasjoner og ledes av regiondirektør i Kristiansand. Vi er opptatt av læring og kontinuerlig forbedring for å sørge for god økonomiforvaltning, internkontroll og gode tjenester til brukerne våre. Det er viktig for oss at du bidrar inn i videreutviklingen av tjenestene våre.  I tillegg til å være en del av det nasjonale økonomiteamet, så har du din personalleder på regionkontoret på Gjøvik og 17 hyggelige kollegaer. Dine kollegaer har både regionale og nasjonale oppgaver innenfor andre fagområder som eksempelvis veiledning og kontroll av driften av asylmottak, informasjon til og opplæring av ansatte i asylmottak, anskaffelser og kontraktsforvaltning og retur av asylsøkere med avslag på sin søknad om beskyttelse.  

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Jobbe med fakturahåndtering og attestasjonskontroll, bilagshåndtering, refusjonskrav og tilskuddsforvaltning 
  • Utbetaling av tilskudd og direkte refunderbare ytelser til beboere    
  • Økonomioppgaver - budsjettering, rapportering og oppfølging 
  • Bidra til en god kontraktsoppfølging, ved å sikre at varer og tjenester har budsjettmessig dekning og er rettidig levert og fakturert i tråd med bestilling, samt dialog med leverandører     
  • Samarbeide med kollegaer om økonomioppgaver på tvers av regioner og enheter     
  • Bidra til å sikre god internkontroll    
  • Bidra inn i øvrige oppgaver i Mottak og retur avhengig av våre behov og din kompetanse   
Kvalifikasjoner

For å lykkes i stillingen må du ha: 

  • bachelor innen økonomi og administrasjon  
  • god systemforståelse og er digitalt nysgjerrig  
  • erfaring med Unit4, eller tilsvarende økonomi og fakturasystemer 
  • erfaring fra å behandle direkterefunderbare ytelser og refusjonskrav 
  • erfaring med økonomioppgaver i offentlig sektor   
  • svært god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk   

Det er ønskelig at du har: 

  • kjennskap til Statens økonomireglement 
  • kunnskap om internkontroll 
  • kompetanse på Mot-systemet 

Som følge av at stillingen er midlertidig med varighet til 31.12.2027 er det ønskelig med snarlig oppstart. 

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som der:

  • analytisk og løsningsorientert – evne til å se helhet, identifisere forbedringsmuligheter 
  • strukturert og nøyaktig – kvalitet i leveranser 
  • fremoverlent og fleksibel – tilpasningsdyktig i endring og tar i bruk ny teknologi 
  • samarbeidsorientert og nysgjerrig – deler kunnskap, søker andres perspektiver og trives med tverrfaglig samarbeid 
  • selvstendig og ansvarlig – tar initiativ og følger opp 
Velkommen til oss!

I UDI er vi opptatt av mangfold. Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. Vi vil tilrettelegge for medarbeidere som har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være tekniske hjelpemidler, tilpasning av møbler eller endring av rutiner, arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid. Har du hull i CV-en din, funksjonell nedsettelse eller innvandringsbakgrunn, vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker stilling hos oss. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert kandidat fra hver av disse gruppen til intervju. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte til å søke hos oss.     Derfor bør du velge oss:   Du får jobbe i en virksomhet med ett av Norges viktigste samfunnsoppdrag. Vi har høy faglig kompetanse, stort engasjement og dyktige medarbeidere. Profesjonalitet, menneskeverd og helhet er verdiene våre. De er viktige for oss, og skal påvirke hvordan vi løser oppgavene våre hver dag.    Du får arbeidssted i moderne lokaler i Storgata 10 på Gjøvik. Vi tilbyr blant annet sommertid, trening i arbeidstiden, fleksitid og fleksibel arbeidsplass – og ikke minst landets beste kollegaer (mener vi).  Stillingen er lønnet som rådgiver (stillingskode 1434) i lønnsspennet 600 000 – 660 000 brutto per år avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. For spesielt kvalifiserte søkere, kan høyere lønn vurderes. Et lønnstrekk på to prosent gir deg gode ordninger for pensjon, lån og forsikringer i Statens pensjonskasse.   Informasjon om søknadsprosessen:   Du søker på stillingen via søknadssystemet Webcruiter. Du må legge ved vitnemål og du laster det direkte ned fra Vitnemålsportalen i Webcruiter (vitnemalsportalen.no). Dersom du har utdanning fra utlandet, må den være godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (hkdir.no).    Vi ber deg om å levere en beskrivende søknad og CV som fremhever din erfaring, kompetanse, og hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen.   Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli utelatt fra denne listen. I så fall må du begrunne hvorfor du ønsker det. Hvis ønsket ditt ikke kan innvilges, tar vi kontakt med deg i forkant   

Vi planlegger for å gjennomføre intervjuer i løpet av 25-26november.

I samarbeid med ekstern leverandør benytter UDI seg av bakgrunnssjekk. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI) gjennomfører regjeringens innvandrings- og flyktningpolitikk og gir faglige innspill til utvikling av politikken. Vi skal legge til rette for lovlig innvandring og hindre misbruk av regelverket. Vi tilbyr også innkvartering til asylsøkere, og bidrar til retur av personer uten lovlig opphold. Menneskeverd, profesjonalitet og helhet er grunnleggende verdier i direktoratet. UDI ligger under Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet. Se også www.udi.no

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business.

This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users.

Your Mission

  • Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production.
  • Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters.
  • Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow.
  • Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day.
  • Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues.
  • Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why.
  • Raise the bar: Share knowledge,

Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end.
  • Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.
  • You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management.
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems.
  • Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma.
  • Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase.
  • Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship.
  • High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English required; German is a plus.
  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Vector search (pgvector or similar).
  • Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.
  • Observability and product analytics tools (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, PostHog).
  • Python for data tooling.
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale or B2B environments.

Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes: Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities: Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.
  • Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment: State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.
  • Company pension program (bAV): Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution, investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership: Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
  • Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage: We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.
  • Free bike options: Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.
  • Complimentary food & beverages: Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.
  • Personalized workspace setup: €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one.
  • Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program): You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.

Sounds like a perfect fit? We can't wait to meet you. Apply now and be part of our journey!

jobs.title: Talent & People Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About VIA HealthTech

VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. That is work which used to cost therapists hours every week.

We are the market leading AI assistant for psychotherapists. Over 4,000 psychotherapists across the DACH region use VIA every day, and we process hundreds of thousands of sessions per month. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and hold a BSI C5 attestation.

We are a multidisciplinary team of 12 in Berlin-Mitte. Being the market leader in AI documentation is our starting position, not our goal. We are going much deeper, into the therapeutic process itself and into how a practice is run, with products that will be regulated as medical devices under EU MDR.

The role

We are 12 today and plan to roughly double in the next year, across engineering, our clinical team and go-to-market. We are bootstrapped. Every salary is paid from revenue, not from a funding round, and a wrong hire costs us a year we cannot buy back. We cannot afford that mistake, so we do not hire good. We hire exceptional.

Today, hiring lands between three founder calendars that are already full, or with agencies. Both fill roles. Neither builds anything that stays. We would rather internalise it: one person who knows our bar, owns the whole pipeline and builds the people function around it. You are not joining an HR team. You are becoming it.

Recruiting is the core of this role, and the measure in year one is simple: every role we open, filled on time with someone excellent, closed by you. Everything else in HR is yours to build lean behind that.

What you'll own

  • The whole funnel, for every role. Briefing with the hiring founder, the job ad, sourcing, screening, interview loops, references, offer, close. You are the first conversation a candidate has with VIA, and the one who gets them over the line

  • Sourcing that does not wait for applications. The people we want are rarely looking. Outbound on LinkedIn and beyond, our network, the places where therapists, engineers and salespeople actually are. We use agencies today. After you, we do not

  • The bar. A process that reliably separates excellent from good: structured interviews, take-home challenges with the hiring team, scorecards, fast decisions. You say no to candidates the founders like, and you say it with reasons

  • Candidate experience. Answers within days, not weeks. Every candidate, hired or not, leaves with a better opinion of VIA than they came with

  • The team as it doubles. Rituals, offsites, the things that keep a company twice this size feeling like the 12-person one that got here

Your profile

  • Builder mentality. Processes, templates and tooling you set up yourself, because there is nobody else to do it

  • Working knowledge of German employment basics: contracts, probation, notice periods and the thresholds that matter as we grow. Payroll and legal are outsourced; you know when to call them

  • Hunger. You want to build the people function of a company that is going to be much bigger, not run one that already exists

  • Fluent German and English. Our candidates and contracts are in German, parts of our team work in English

Strong plus

  • You have been the first People hire somewhere and built from zero

  • Employer branding, from the careers page to events

  • AI tools as a matter of course. One person using them well replaces a recruiting team

  • You hire to fill a seat. We would rather leave it empty

Une bonne connaissance des moteurs, de l'environnement mécanique, électronique et électrique, des moyens de mesures (instrumentation, principe de chaine de mesure, etc.) est indispensable. Vous êtes familier des logiciels scientifiques du domaine d'application (AMESIM, GtPower, IPG maker). Vous êtes capable de vous exprimer couramment en anglais. jobs.title: varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja
jobs.description: Miksi Orimattilaan?Orimattilan varhaiskasvatuksessa työskentelee kolme konsultoivaa ja yksi ryhmässä toimiva varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja. Saat tueksesi osaavan kollegaverkoston, toimivat rakenteet sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää erityisopetusta koko varhaiskasvatuksessa sekä yhteistyössä myös perusopetuksen kanssa.Arvostamme työssämme kiireettömyyttä, lämmintä vuorovaikutusta, positiivista pedagogiikkaa sekä inklusiivista toimintakulttuuria.TehtäväsiTyöalueesi on kooltaan hallittava ja mahdollistaa aidosti lasten, huoltajien ja henkilöstön tukemisen. Tehtävässäsi arvioit lasten tuen tarpeita sekä suunnittelet ja toteutat pedagogista tukea. Työhösi kuuluu konsultointia, pedagogisten ratkaisujen mallintamista, yhteis- ja samanaikaisopetusta, leikin tukemista sekä lapsikohtaisen tuen toteuttamista esiopetuksessa. Tuet henkilöstöä käytännönläheisesti arjen tilanteissa ja vahvistat koko työyhteisön osaamista.Työssäsi keskeisessä roolissa on yhteistyö huoltajien, lapsiryhmien henkilökunnan ja päiväkodin johtajien kanssa. Lisäksi teet monipuolista verkostoyhteistyötä hyvinvointialueen ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Erityisopetuksen kehittämisryhmässä arvioitte yhdessä perusopetuksen erityisopettajien kanssa toimintatapoja, nivelvaiheyhteistyötä ja prosesseja sekä viette uusia toimintamalleja käytäntöön.Toimistosi sijaitsee Koivikon päiväkodissa ja esihenkilönäsi toimii varhaiskasvatuspäällikkö. Työskentelet pääasiassa oman alueesi yksiköissä, mutta osallistut myös varhaiskasvatuspalveluiden kehittämiseen laajennetun johtoryhmän jäsenenä sekä mahdollisuuksien mukaan sisäisenä kouluttajana.Mitä toivomme sinulta?Odotamme sinulta hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja, myönteistä asennetta sekä joustavaa, ratkaisukeskeistä ja kehittävää työotetta.Arvostamme erityisesti:- aktiivista ja rakentavaa vuorovaikutustapaa rohkeutta nostaa kehittämiskohteita esille ja edistää niiden toteutumista- kykyä sanoittaa varhaiserityisopetusta selkeästi ja ymmärrettävästi- taitoa oivalluttaa henkilöstöä oman työnsä äärellä- itsenäistä työotetta oman työn suunnitteluun ja aikatauluttamiseen- käytännönläheistä ja ymmärrettävää kirjallista ilmaisua- erityispedagogista osaamista ja käytännön kokemusta.Mitä tarjoamme?Saat tueksesi:- asiantuntevan ja kannustavan erityisopettajatiimin- työyhteisön, jossa omaa työtä arvioidaan ja kehitetään yhdessä- johtamisrakenteiden vahvan tuen- säännöllisen ryhmätyönohjauksen- mahdollisuuden kouluttautua ja kehittää osaamistasi- tutkittua tietoa varhaiskasvatuksemme kehittämisen tueksi- toimivat monialaisen yhteistyön käytännöt- digipedagogiikan tarjoamat mahdollisuudet- Mehiläisen työterveyspalvelut- liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun- maalaiskaupungin työrauhaaTyöhyvinvointikyselymme (10/2026) mukaan varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajat arvioivat työnsä erittäin myönteisesti. Työyhteisön tuki sai arvosanan 4,8/5, ammatillisen kehittymisen mahdollisuudet 5/5 ja lähiesihenkilötyö 4,4/5.Edellytämme varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 6 luvun 30 § tai siirtymäsäännöksen (75 §) mukaista kelpoisuutta. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää siirtymistä eri yksiköiden välillä, mikä on hyvä huomioida tehtävää haettaessa. Matkakustannukset korvataan. Valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta.Jos tehtävään ei saada henkilöä, jolla on säädetty kelpoisuus, tehtävään voidaan ottaa enintään vuoden ajaksi kerrallaan henkilö, jolla suoritettujen opintojen perusteella on riittävät edellytykset ja tehtävän edellyttämä taito tehtävän hoitamiseen.3169, 67 €/kk. Kelpoisuudesta maksamme kuukausittaista rekrytointilisää 400 €. Lisäksi maksetaan muut valtakunnalliset lisät ja työkokemuslisä.

jobs.title: Inntil 100 prosent vikariat i markedsføring og ledelse, økonomi og ledelse og samfunnskunnskap
jobs.description:
Ålesund videregående skole søker lærer til et vikariat i inntil 100 prosent med snarlig tiltredelse. Vikariatet varer ut skoleåret 2026/2027. Stillingen omfatter undervisning i markedsføring og ledelse, økonomi og ledelse og samfunnskunnskap. Dersom ingen søkere har den ønskede fagkombinasjonen, kan det være aktuelt å dele opp stillingen i mindre stillinger eller tilby undervisning i andre fag i kombinasjon med deler av stillingen. Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Undervisning i markedsføring og ledelse 1 og 2, økonomi og ledelse og samfunnskunnskap.
  • Planlegging, gjennomføring og evaluering av undervisning i tråd med gjeldende læreplaner.
  • Underveisvurdering, sluttvurdering og tett oppfølging av elevenes faglige og sosiale utvikling.
  • Aktiv deltakelse i fagseksjoner, profesjonsfellesskap og skolen sitt utviklingsarbeid.
  • Bidra til et trygt, inkluderende og motiverende læringsmiljø for elevene.
  • Samarbeid med hjemmet, rådgivere og andre støttefunksjoner ved behov.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent undervisningskompetanse (minimum 60 studiepoeng) i ett eller flere av fagene markedsføring og ledelse, økonomi og ledelse og samfunnskunnskap.
  • Godkjent praktisk-pedagogisk utdanning (PPU) eller annen relevant pedagogisk utdanning. For søkere med særlig relevant kompetanse og erfaring kan kravet om pedagogisk utdanning fravikes, i tråd med gjeldende regelverk.
  • God kjennskap til læreplanverket (LK20).
  • Undervisningserfaring fra videregående opplæring er ønskelig.
  • Digital kompetanse og evne til å ta i bruk varierte undervisningsmetoder.
Personlege eigenskaper
  • Du har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner.
  • Du er en tydelig og trygg klasseleder.
  • Du er strukturert, fleksibel og løsningsorientert.
  • Du bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø og et godt profesjonsfellesskap.
  • Du er engasjert og har et positivt elevsyn.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
  • Det stilles krav om tilfredsstillende politiattest i samsvar med opplæringsloven. Politiattesten må fremlegges før tiltredelse.
Vi tilbyr
  • Et engasjert og faglig sterkt kollegium.
  • Mulighet for faglig og pedagogisk utvikling.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, deling og fokus på elevenes læring og mestring.
  • Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver i en spennende skolehverdag.
  • Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i samsvar med gjeldende avtaleverk.

Om skolen: 

Ålesund videregående skole er den største i fylket med ca. 1300 elevar og eit stort mangfald av både studieførebuande og yrkesfaglege utdanningar. Vi er lokalisert på Campus Ålesund (i Fagerlia) og på Volsdalsberga, med nært og godt samarbeid med NTNU Ålesund, Fagskolen Møre og Romsdal og regionalt nærings- og kulturliv. Vi skal vere ein attraktiv og framoverlent skole med høg elevgjennomføring, og som leverer relevant kompetanse for både arbeidsliv og høgare utdanning.

jobs.title: TECHNICIEN DE MAINTENANCE INDUSTRIELLE (H/F)
jobs.description: Depuis plus de 20 ans, CENEXI est un groupe pharmaceutique sous-traitant (CDMO) spécialisé dans le développement et la fabrication de médicaments. Acteur clé de l'industrie pharmaceutique, il accompagne ses partenaires à chaque étape du cycle de vie de leurs produits. Le groupe compte près de 1 300 collaborateurs répartis sur 4 sites en Europe. Site de Fontenay-sous-Bois (à 9 km de Paris) - 620 collaborateurs - Site stratégique du groupe, dédié à la production de formes liquides et solides, et reconnu comme centre d'excellence pour les produits injectables.MISSIONS :  Nous recrutons des techniciens de maintenance à dominante électricité / électrotechnique pour renforcer notre équipe maintenance sur notre site de production. Rattachés au chef d'équipe et au Responsable Maintenance du secteur, vous êtes le référent des interventions électriques et participez activement à la fiabilité des installations. - Réalisation et proposition des interventions de maintenance préventive, corrective et améliorative sur les équipements.- Diagnostic des pannes et dysfonctionnements, dépannage, remise en état et réglage des équipements, avec proposition d'actions d'amélioration.- Suivi et analyse des performances des équipements de production (indicateurs, incidents, taux de disponibilité.).- Intervention sur les armoires électriques, capteurs, variateurs de vitesse, moteurs ainsi que sur les circuits de puissance et de commande.- Réalisation des contrôles, essais et réglages électriques après intervention afin de garantir la conformité et la sécurité des installations.- Participation aux modifications électriques, au câblage et à l'installation de nouveaux équipements ou à l'évolution des installations existantes.- Élaboration des modes opératoires de maintenance et mise à jour de la documentation technique.- Participation à la qualification et à la remise en service des équipements après intervention.- Formation et accompagnement des équipes de production à l'utilisation des équipements.- Accompagnement des entreprises extérieures lors des interventions et veille au respect des règles de sécurité.CONDITIONS :- Horaires en 3*8 (6h30-13h50 / 13h40-21h / 20h50-06h40)

jobs.title: Responsable petite enfance, enfance, parentalité (H/F)

Participer à la dynamique collective de l'association- Prendre part aux réunions internes et, en lien avec le coordinateur, aux groupes de travail consacrés à la petite enfance, à l'enfance et à la parentalité à l'échelle duquartier, de la Ville et de l'agglomération.- Rendre compte de son activité auprès du coordinateur et contribuer à l'évaluation des projets.- Participer à l'évolution des actions en fonction des besoins repérés.- Mobiliser les ressources, les compétences et les espaces de l'association au service des projets.- Respecter les procédures internes, le cadre conventionnel et la législation en vigueur.Profil recherchéFormation- BPJEPS ou diplôme de niveau 4 minimum dans les domaines de l'animationsocioculturelle, de l'action sociale ou de l'économie sociale et solidaire (ESS).Expérience- Expérience significative auprès des enfants et des familles.- Expérience en coordination ou en responsabilité d'équipe appréciée.- Une connaissance du fonctionnement associatif et du travail partenarial constitue un atout.Compétences et qualités- Capacités d'organisation, de coordination et de conduite de projets.- Aisance relationnelle, sens de l'écoute et capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance avec les familles.- Aptitude au travail en équipe et en partenariat.- Capacité à prendre des initiatives Travail du mardi au vendredi.Les candidatures sont à transmettre au plus tard le 17 novembre 2026.Prise de poste le 3 Décembre 2026

jobs.title: Technicien Essais CDI AIRBUS (H/F)
jobs.description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Technicien Essai (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Essais basé à Toulouse, France.En tant que Technicien Essai, vous serez intégré au sein d'une équipe de 30 personnes qui développe les essais sur la ligne d'assemblage. Vos challenges:> Réaliser et vérifier les tests opérationnels et attester de la conformité de l'avion;> Assurer la sécurité des personnes et de l'avion;> Exécuter le test au sol suivant l'instruction de test au sol (GTI) et l'instruction de test répété (RTI) et leurs ordres de travail associés en fonction de la qualité, du coût et du temps;> Extraire les schémas électriques pour le dépannage et effectuer un test spécifique pour identifier la cause première de la défaillance;> Travailler sur la résolution de problème pour l'amélioration continue;> Réaliser de la prévention concernant les objets non identifiés (FOD);> Déclarer et suivre les non conformités (NC) pour reprise ou certification;> Faire remonter les demandes utilisateur (DU) vers la conception pour améliorer les données d'entrée pertinentes pour GTI;> Collaborer avec le Ground Test Design, Bureau d'Etude (BE), les inspecteurs Qualité, les Mécaniciens ou les Responsables d'atelier;> Gérer la mise à jour de toutes les documentations sur les remarques de sa responsabilité (NC, DU, .)Votre carte d'embarquement:  - Vous possédez minimum 5 ans d'expérience en tant que technicien essai;  - Compétence : Green ou Cabin;  - Notion de SAPVotre environnement de travail :Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :   - Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d'intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus et plan d'actionnariat salarié avec attribution d'actions gratuites sur la base du volontariat.   - Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d'autres services.    - Bien-être / santé: Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.    - Développement individuel: Des opportunités d'évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.Vous ne matchez pas à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement.

jobs.title: Boendestödjare till Fokushuset Norrtälje | Tiohundra
jobs.description: Välkommen att bli en del av Fokushuset, en unik verksamhet med inriktning psykiatri, beroende och socialpsykiatri med ett salutogent fokus. Vi söker nu en boendestödjare som vill vara en del av vårt härliga team och ta sig an ett värdefullt arbete som gör skillnad på riktigt. Välkommen med din ansökan!Om tjänstenSom boendestödjare på Fokushuset utgår du från Norrtälje där du också har dina uppdrag, samt i Rimbo med omnejd. Du hjälper vuxna personer mellan 18 till 65 år som har olika stödbehov utifrån en psykiatrisk funktionsnedsättning eller samsjuklighet. Du arbetar främst i deras hem. Brukarens individuella behov och önskemål är det som styr ditt arbete, och du ger värdefullt stöd i det dagliga livet utifrån metoderna ESL och MI. Du arbetar med, inte åt, den som behöver stöd. Du stödjer mot en ökad självständighet genom att skapa förutsättningar för att lättare kunna hantera vardagen tillsammans med brukaren. Anställningen är en tillsvidaretjänst. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:    Utföra insatser hemma hos kund utifrån biståndsbeslut.    Planera, genomföra och vara delaktig i vardagssysslor.    Motivera brukaren till att utveckla och använda sina egna färdigheter.    Att vara ett stöd vid kontakter med myndigheter.    Följa med på aktiviteter.    Utföra digitalt boendestöd genom videosamtal.    Dokumentera.Om vårt erbjudandeVi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande tjänst där du som boendestödjare får vara med och bidra till förändring och förbättring för våra kunder. Vi erbjuder regelbunden handledning tillsammans med övriga teamet och en stark sammanhållning. Vi har ett brett utbud av förmåner kopplade till bland annat hälsa och välmående, en förmånlig tjänstepensionsavsättning om 6% av månadslönen, gemenskapsfrämjande aktiviteter, extra semesterdagar från vissa åldrar, föräldrapenningtillägg samt möjlighet att arbeta deltid tills ditt barn fyller 12 år. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr per år via vårt system Epassi där många aktörer i kommunen finns. Om digFör den här tjänsten behöver du:    Erfarenhet av målgruppen.    Minst en gymnasieutbildning inom vård och omsorg eller annan likvärdig utbildning.    B-körkort samt körvana. jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. You will own the hands-on configuration and rollout of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Device Trust and Unified Access while delivering tailored, high-impact training that drives deep adoption and long-term customer value. Partnering with a Project Manager, Technical Account Managers, and Solutions Architects, you will be the trusted authority in each engagement, bringing both advanced product expertise and sharp business acumen to complex, high-visibility deployments. You will approach your work as an AI builder by actively developing AI-powered workflows and automation to scale your impact, accelerate outcomes for customers, and raise the standard for what implementation excellence looks like at 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

What we're looking for:

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to engage and develop relationships, sharing information effectively across all professional levels.

  • Excellent communication in Spanish is a plus

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, customer onboarding, or related B2B SaaS function, with a demonstrated track record of leading enterprise software deployments for large, complex, or strategically critical organizations

  • Advanced technical expertise and hands-on experience deploying SaaS products in enterprise environments, including deep working knowledge of identity providers (IdPs), SSO, SCIM, Active Directory, MDM, device trust, and Zero Trust security frameworks

  • Expert-level understanding of the business cases for enterprise security, IT operations, and SaaS governance tools and able to fluently navigate both technical and strategic conversations with IT administrators, security teams, and C-suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, high-visibility enterprise engagements with multiple competing priorities, maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines

  • Proven ability to design and deliver advanced, engaging virtual training and enablement programs for enterprise customers, including technically sophisticated administrators and executive audiences

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leadership and serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders

  • Strong judgment in identifying and resolving technical issues, with the ability to lead de-escalation efforts and drive outcomes autonomously

  • A builder's mindset toward AI. You actively develop with AI tools and automation, creating workflows, solutions, and accelerators that meaningfully improve how you and your team work; you are not a casual user but a practitioner who builds

  • Experience mentoring and coaching peers and junior team members, sharing expertise and elevating the capability of those around you

  • Familiarity with SCIM, AD/LDAP, CLI, SSO, BYOD, MDM, SaaS discovery, and device posture concepts

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 1Password or experience deploying identity and access management, password management, device trust, or SaaS management solutions at enterprise scale

What you can expect:

  • Drive the successful technical implementation and deployment of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, and Device Trust (and Unified Access as it becomes available) for large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, owning hands-on configuration, integration, and validation through to a successful launch

  • Partner with the assigned Project Manager to align on timelines, dependencies, and internal coordination. You own the technical delivery and customer enablement while the Project Manager owns project coordination; together you ensure a seamless, high-quality customer experience

  • Collaborate closely with Technical Account Managers and Solutions Architects to assess customer environments, align on architectural decisions, and design implementation approaches that meet both technical requirements and business objectives

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's environment, security posture, business goals, and user workflows in order to design deployment strategies and training plans that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Deliver advanced, customized virtual training sessions for enterprise administrators and end users across all deployed 1Password products while adapting instructional approaches to technically diverse audiences and highly complex organizational environments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for customers and internal stakeholders alike, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from IT and security teams to executive leadership

  • Manage escalated situations on complex or sensitive implementations, working cross-functionally with internal teams and engaging directly with customers to de-escalate and drive the best possible outcome

  • Exercise independent judgment in identifying and mitigating implementation risks, developing and executing resolution strategies proactively and keeping all relevant stakeholders informed

  • Stay ahead of product updates, new features, and evolving integrations across our products and applying that knowledge immediately in customer engagements and sharing it with the broader team

  • Develop and maintain advanced implementation playbooks, training curricula, and enablement resources (including configuration guides, deployment frameworks, and possibly video content) that elevate the capabilities of the entire Implementations and Onboarding team

  • Mentor Implementation Managers and other junior team members, sharing deep product expertise, enterprise deployment strategies, and insights gained from working with our most demanding customers

  • Influence team operations by leveraging lessons from complex engagements to recommend and drive improvements to team practices, processes, documentation, and the overall customer journey

  • Build with AI not just use it. Actively develop AI-powered workflows, automation, and tools that improve your own delivery, help customers achieve faster time-to-value, and create scalable solutions the broader team can adopt

  • Contribute significantly to the growth strategy of the Implementations function, identifying opportunities to evolve how we deploy and enable customers at scale

  • Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £61,000 GBP and £88,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.title: Director Service Accounts (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Director Service Accounts @ Sereact 🦾

Director Service Accounts (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites across Europe · Reports to the VP Operations · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

The Site Acceptance Test is where a deployment ends and a customer’s operation begins. From that day our robots pick in someone else’s building, every shift, against targets the customer measures. Many of our customers buy Sereact as a service: they pay for robots that work, not for robots that were delivered.

Our deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the site that performs is the site that grows. We now want one leader who owns every live site from SAT on: keeps it at target, brings it everything we ship in software and hardware, speaks for the customer inside Sereact, and turns a working site into a growing one.

The Real-World Learning Loop runs through your sites

Cortex learns from live deployments. Every station at a customer is part of that loop, so a station that is down is more than a service problem: a cell sitting dark is a stopped sensor.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every live station runs the current policy in a real operation. Your surface on it: each site at target, every shift.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: stations that run and stay connected, so the data keeps coming.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Failures and edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: what your sites tell us reaches engineering and research with the context they need.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. Your surface on it: they land in your customers’ operations on a schedule the customer can plan around, with a way back if something is off.

A site that runs well teaches Cortex more, and it grows.

Responsibilities

  • Take over every site at SAT. Set the standard for what a site needs before your team takes it on: documentation, open points, spare parts, contacts and targets. If a site is not ready, it stays with deployment until it is.

  • Keep every site at target. Own each site’s performance against its contract: availability, throughput and pick success. See a problem coming before the customer does, and run the recovery plan when a site falls behind.

  • Run planned change. Software releases and model updates reach customer operations in a rhythm customers can plan around: release notes, change windows, blackout periods, validation on site and a rollback path.

  • Run hardware updates and retrofits across the installed base, from new gripper generations to station upgrades and fixes, with Hardware Engineering and the field teams, without stopping the customer’s operation.

  • Get every site ready for peak: hypercare and coverage plans for the weeks that matter most to our customers, from Black Friday to the January returns wave.

  • Be the customer’s advocate inside Sereact. Bring their priorities into product, R&D, hardware and operations, make sure what we promised at SAT holds, and own the customer communication when something goes wrong.

  • Take each site from SAT to expansion with Strategic Accounts: the performance evidence, the site capacity and the technical plan for the next stations. Strategic Accounts own the contract; you make the expansion ready to happen.

  • Report site health customers trust: one view of every site, monthly performance reports and the operational part of every business review.

  • Build and lead the Service Accounts team: Service Account Managers who each own a portfolio of live sites, and a playbook that still works when the installed base is ten times larger.

  • Work hand in hand with Deployment, Technical Support & Field Service, Hardware Engineering, R&D and Strategic Accounts, so a live site gets one coordinated answer, not five.

Not in scope, by design

  • Deployment up to SAT stays with our deployment teams. You set the bar for what you take over.

  • Incidents, the support desk, field technicians and spare parts logistics stay with Technical Support & Field Service. You own the site; they own the ticket.

  • Contracts, pricing and the expansion deal itself stay with Strategic Accounts. You make the case; they sign it.

  • Product and hardware design stay with engineering. You bring them what the field needs.

What makes this role hard

  • Every change to a live operation is a risk, and not changing is a risk too: the fleet only gets better if updates reach it. You make both safe.

  • Our robots work in other people’s buildings: their WMS, their conveyors, their shift patterns, their peak. Much of what decides a site’s performance is not ours, and it is still your problem.

  • You sit between the customer and our teams. Sometimes the customer’s priority is not ours. You argue for it, or you explain honestly why not.

  • The installed base grows faster than any team. What works by heroics today breaks at ten times the size.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know every live site and its people; one named owner, one health view and a clear status against target for each; a handover standard at SAT agreed with deployment.

  • By month 6: releases and retrofits in a rhythm customers can plan around; peak season run on hypercare plans; account plans with Strategic Accounts for the largest customers; the first Service Account Managers hired.

  • By month 12: every site at target or on a dated recovery plan; expansions coming out of the installed base; a playbook ready to take to the US.

What you bring

  • 8+ years owning live installations of complex automation after go-live (warehouse automation, intralogistics, robotics or comparable 24/7 systems), as service account manager, technical account manager, customer success or service delivery lead, including at least three years leading a team.

  • You did it while the installed base grew from tens to hundreds of sites, and you built the processes rather than inheriting them.

  • Technical enough to read a log, follow a root cause and hold your own with engineers. Commercial enough to sit with a customer’s operations director and talk performance, cost and growth.

  • You have run releases, upgrades and retrofit programs in live operations without stopping them.

  • Customers trust you because you tell them early and you tell them straight.

  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a plus.

  • You are happy to spend a large part of your week at customer sites.

Nice to have: subscription or Robotics-as-a-Service models · goods-to-person and AS/RS integrations · e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment · experience in both a scale-up and an established automation vendor.

Not the right fit: account management without technical depth, or running a ticket queue without ever owning a customer.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a live site that fell behind its targets. What did you change in the first two weeks, and how did it end?

  2. A customer’s peak starts in four weeks. Engineering wants to ship a model update and a gripper retrofit before then. What do you do?

  3. How do you know a site is about to grow, or about to leave, before the customer tells you?

What we offer

  • A fleet in live production that grows every month, and the mandate to build the team that keeps it at target.

  • A key role in the operations leadership of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity.

  • Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site.

  • Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston.

How we hire

Conversations with our VP Operations and the founders, a working session on a real case from one of our live sites, and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast.

jobs.title: Director Solutions (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Director Solutions (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites in Europe and the US · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

A robot deal is won twice: once when the contract is signed, and once when the cell runs the customer’s orders at the throughput we promised. The distance between the two is decided before anyone unpacks a crate: by the site survey, the item spectrum, the cell concept, the integration with the customer’s warehouse systems, and by the number we write into the contract.

We are moving from single stations to fleets, with customers who order dozens of systems at once. The deals are getting larger, the sites more varied, and a concept that does not fit the site is paid for in months of commissioning. We are looking for the technical counterpart to our sales team: a leader who sits next to every account executive from the first conversation and makes deals technically feasible. Someone who has deployed robots personally, knows what a real site does to a design, finds the solution that makes the customer’s use case work, and makes sure what we promise is what we can build.

The Real-World Learning Loop starts with your design

Cortex learns from live deployments. The cell you design is the body the model works in, and a concept that goes live in weeks instead of months is weeks of real-world data no one else has.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every station runs the current policy on the customer’s items. Your surface on it: reach, camera placement and item presentation that let the policy do its job on day one.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: standard cells with a known stack wherever possible, so every pick teaches the same model.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: the item spectrum and the sample tests you run before signature, so curation starts before go-live.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies return to the fleet after validation. Your surface on it: concepts that transfer, so a policy proven on one cell works on the next.

A site designed right goes live faster, teaches Cortex more, and grows.

Responsibilities

  • Be Sales’ technical counterpart on every deal. One solutions lead next to every account executive, from the first customer conversation to signature. Your job is to make the deal technically feasible: understand the customer’s process, find the solution that works for their site and items, and give Sales a technical story the customer’s engineers believe.

  • Own the technical solution for every deal, from the first site visit to the signed scope: site survey, process and material-flow analysis, item spectrum, cell concept and layout, reach and camera study, integration concept for WMS, WCS and conveyors, safety concept. One package per deal, and you are accountable for it.

  • Set the number. Throughput, pick success and intervention rates we commit to per site, derived from the item spectrum and the site and checked against what comparable live sites actually do. No KPI goes into a contract without your sign-off.

  • Standard first. Configure our standard single-arm, dual-arm and mobile products to the site. Every deviation is a documented decision taken with Engineering, not a discovery during installation.

  • Run the gate. No contract is signed without your solution design sign-off and a delivery slot agreed with Operations. You hold the pen on the technical statement of work, the acceptance criteria and the site-readiness list the customer has to meet.

  • Make it feasible, fast. Sample tests, pick studies and scanning or dimensioning checks with our applied AI team, within days, not months. When a requirement does not fit, find the version that does: a different cell or item presentation, a phased scope, a pilot that proves the hard part first. A no is the last answer, not the first.

  • Own the interfaces to integrators and WMS vendors at the solution level, from AutoStore and goods-to-person systems to conveyor and WMS partners: interface specs, a clear split of responsibilities and readiness tests before we ship.

  • Build the solution library: reference designs per use case (goods-to-person ports, put walls, returns, decanting, store replenishment), throughput models, layout templates and integration patterns, so the tenth deal of a kind takes a day, not a month.

  • Close the loop from the field. What commissioning and live sites learn about a design flows back into the reference concepts and into requirements for Product and Engineering.

  • Build and lead the Solutions team in Europe and the US: solutions engineers who have stood at a cell, with the playbooks and tools (CAD, simulation, throughput models) to do this at ten times today’s deal flow.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations and Deployment, Service Accounts, Systems Engineering, Applied AI and Supply Chain. Report to the CEO and be part of the leadership team.

Not in scope, by design

  • Pricing, contract terms and closing stay with Sales. You are their technical counterpart: you own what we promise technically, how we make it work and when it can be delivered.

  • Build, installation and commissioning up to the Site Acceptance Test stay with Operations. You hand over a package that builds, and you stay accountable for the concept.

What makes this role hard

  • Your job is to find the yes we can deliver. Most of the time that means a smarter solution, sometimes a different scope or a later date, and occasionally a no to a deal the company wants. When it is a no, you have to be right about it, with numbers.

  • The product moves fast: what the model could not do in spring it may do in autumn. You commit to today’s capability and plan for tomorrow’s, and you do not confuse the two.

  • By month 12: deals signed in 2027 go live at the throughput in the concept, without redesign; a Solutions team in Europe and the US; a library that makes the standard deal routine.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in warehouse or factory automation, several of them in solutions, application engineering or deployment of robotic systems. You have personally deployed robots in live operations, from site survey to commissioning: piece-picking arms, dual-arm cells, mobile manipulators or AMR fleets. You know what a go-live night feels like.

  • You did it while your company grew from its first sites to dozens or hundreds, and you built the solution process rather than inheriting it.

  • You can do the work yourself: a site survey, a layout in CAD, a material-flow and throughput model, an interface specification for a WMS or WCS (APIs, PLC handshakes), a risk assessment for a cell. And you can explain it to a customer’s operations director and to our machine learning engineers in the same afternoon.

  • You have worked side by side with sales teams as their technical counterpart and helped win deals by finding a solution that works. You have led solutions or application engineers, and when a sales team pushed for a bigger number, you held the line with evidence.

  • You know the intralogistics ecosystem: AutoStore and goods-to-person systems, conveyors, the integrators; ideally e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus, since many of our customers are in the DACH region. You are happy to spend a large part of your time at customer sites in Europe and the US.

Nice to have: piece-picking or dual-arm robotics · systems whose capability is driven by machine learning and moves every quarter · robotics-as-a-service models · deployments in the US.

Not the right fit: pre-sales architects who have never commissioned a system, solutions as slide-making, or anyone who needs a finished product specification before they can start.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Walk us through a site you designed that went live at the throughput you promised, and one that did not. What was the difference?

  2. Sales wants to sign a deal this quarter with a KPI 50% above what your model says the site can do. What do you do in the next 48 hours to still make the deal work?

  3. A customer’s goods-to-person ports are fixed, and the layout leaves 30 cm less reach than our standard cell needs. What are the options, and which one do you choose?

What we offer

How we hire

Conversations with the founders and our VP Operations, a working session on a real site (we give you a layout, an item spectrum and a target; you tell us what to build and what to promise), and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast.

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

  • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

  • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

  • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

  • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

  • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

  • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

  • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

  • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

  • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

AI at Mollie

jobs.title: Privacy & Product Counsel
jobs.description:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany/ San Francisco, USA or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.


Why This Role

Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI.

We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics.

What You’ll Work On

  • Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping.

  • Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims.

  • Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required.

  • Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do.

  • International transfers and vendors. Manage EU–US transfer mechanisms (SCCs, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and TIAs), and run privacy diligence on sub-processors and AI tooling.

  • US privacy. Track and implement obligations under US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and peers) and emerging AI-specific state legislation.

  • Regulatory interface. Prepare BFL for engagement with data protection authorities, and handle data subject requests, complaints and incidents, including breach assessment and notification.

  • Policy and documentation. Draft and maintain privacy notices, internal policies, records of processing and the privacy elements of compliance documentation.

  • Scale the function. Build playbooks, templates and training so the rest of BFL can handle routine privacy questions without you.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years’ PQE as a qualified lawyer in an EU/EEA jurisdiction or the UK, with a substantial focus on data protection and product counselling

  • Experience at a technology company, in a top-tier law firm’s privacy or tech practice, or both – ideally including time in-house advising product teams directly

  • Deep, practical command of the GDPR (and the German BDSG), the ePrivacy framework and international transfer rules, plus a working knowledge of how other relevant EU regulations, such as the EU AI Act, interact with them

  • Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes)

  • A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions

  • Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance

  • Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike

  • An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media

  • Direct experience engaging with data protection authorities or the EU AI Office

  • CIPP/E, CIPT or equivalent certification

  • German language skills

  • An interest in adjacent areas such as security and trust & safety


How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg / San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Closing

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.


Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity
US $200,000 - $250,000 USD

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into an AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll have experience building content in generative and/or agentic AI — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of tricky subjects is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build AI programmes and content where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into content that actually gets learners there.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Plus one of:

jobs.description: Nu söker vi på Villa Näs en Verksamhetschef på heltid. Vi erbjuder ledarskapsutbildning och flera förmåner.Inom Vardaga är vi i ständig utveckling. Hos oss kan du växa som person samtidigt som du gör skillnad för andra. Vår kultur genomsyras av våra värderingar – respekt, ansvar, enkelhet och kunskap.Här några av höjdpunkterna i vårt erbjudande till dig:    Ledarprogram via vår egen utbildningsorganisation Lära     Förmånsportal med rabatter och erbjudanden     Tydliga arbetssätt för att ge den bästa omsorgen till våra boende     Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter     Friskvårdsbidrag, skobidrag och arbetskläder     KollektivavtalOm rollenI rollen som verksamhetschef så leder och utvecklar du verksamhetens kvalitet på ett pedagogiskt och affärsmässigt sätt.
