jobs.title: Behandlingspedagog som vill göra skillnad till SiS Bärby
jobs.description: Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.   SiS ungdomshem Bärby utanför Uppsala tar emot icke skolpliktiga pojkar med psykosocial problematik samt kriminalitet och missbruk. ArbetsbeskrivningVill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper  inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera.Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt. Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag - kväll och helg.Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor.  I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet.KvalifikationerFör att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.Du ska också ha:     Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig    B- körkort    God svenska i tal och skriftMeriterande:    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer, t.ex. arbete inom psykiatri eller inom LSS omsorg    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Kriminalvården, t.ex. Kriminalvårdare    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Migrationsverket, t.ex. handläggare på Förvaret    Utbildning inom vård-och omsorg    Erfarenhet av arbete med vår målgrupp (t.ex. missbruksvård, ungdomsvård etc.)På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.Anställning: Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Tester och arbetsprover kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen. Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast 2026-11-26. SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande. För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning. Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande. OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller
jobs.description: Som ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller har du en bred och omväxlande roll där ekonomi, redovisning, fastighetsadministration och verksamhetsstöd möts. Du arbetar med den löpande ekonomihanteringen för våra olika enheter och delar ansvaret för redovisningen med övriga inom ekonomiavdelningen. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat leverantörs- och kundreskontra, fakturering, avstämningar, moms- och skattedeklarationer samt medverkan i kvartals- och årsbokslut och administration av våra bostadsaktiebolag.En viktig del av uppdraget är också att fungera som controller och administrativt stöd för organisationens verksamheter. I takt med verksamhetens utveckling kan tjänsten även komma att omfatta stöd till Folkhälsan på Ålands lokalföreningar. Du följer upp verksamheternas ekonomi, nyckeltal och resursanvändning samt tar fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag som stöd för planering och uppföljning. Du fungerar som ett stöd för chefer i ekonomiska och administrativa frågor och bidrar till att utveckla och effektivisera rutiner och arbetssätt.För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad, noggrann och självgående. Du har god analytisk förmåga och tycker om att arbeta med både detaljer och helheter. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor och varierande uppgifter, vilket förutsätter god samarbetsförmåga, flexibilitet och ett serviceinriktat arbetssätt.Vi söker dig som har en tradenom examen eller annan lämplig högskoleutbildning inom ekonomi samt erfarenhet av bokföring och redovisning. Du har god datorvana, är trygg i att arbeta med ekonomiska underlag och har intresse för verksamhetsuppföljning och utveckling. Vi fäster stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Tjänsten är ett moderskapsvikariat på heltid, cirka 12 månader. Då organisationen är under utveckling och tjänstens ansvarsområde kan komma att utökas finns möjlighet till förlängning eller fortsatt anställning efter vikariatets slut.Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Intervjuer kan ske löpande under rekryteringsperioden.Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

jobs.title: Experienced forklift driver for cold storage production
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working at -20°C and have strong forklift skills?

We are currently looking for an experienced and reliable forklift driver to drive the forklift in a cold storage production, handling fresh and frozen poultry products.

You will be working in a storage facility with temperatures around -20°C, and it is important that you are comfortable working in a cold environment throughout your shift. We are looking for someone who thrives in these conditions and understands the importance of maintaining both safety and efficiency while working in cold temperatures.

The warehouse has narrow aisles and limited operating space, making forklift experience essential. Precision, awareness, and safe operation are critical to success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Receiving fresh poultry products from production

  • Transporting fresh products into the freezer for freezing

  • Moving frozen products throughout the warehouse using a forklift

  • Preparing products for shipment and distribution

  • Handling shipping documents, labels, and product identification

  • Ensuring correct traceability and documentation

  • Maintaining order and cleanliness throughout the freezer warehouse

  • Assisting with daily warehouse and logistics operations

  • Following all food safety, quality, and safety procedures

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Holds a valid forklift certificate/license

  • Has solid forklift driving experience from warehouse, logistics, or production companies.

  • Is comfortable working in temperatures of approximately -20°C

  • Thrives in a cold working environment and can maintain a high level of performance throughout the day

  • Has experience operating forklifts in narrow aisles and confined spaces

  • Understands the importance of safe and accurate forklift operation

  • Works independently and takes responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Is structured, quality-conscious, and reliable

  • Has experience working with shipping documents, labels, and warehouse procedures

  • Takes pride in keeping the warehouse organized and efficient

Working Hours

  • Monday to Thursday: Start at 08:35 AM and work until all scheduled tasks are completed

  • Every 6th & 7th Friday: Start at 08:35 AM

  • 37 hours a week, overtime should be expected.

We Offer

  • A stable full-time position in a growing company

  • Long-term employment opportunities

  • A professional and supportive working environment

  • An important role within the warehouse and logistics operation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

  • Immediate start for the right candidate

Location: Horsens, orsensDenmarkStart Date: As soon as possibleEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: Based on qualifications and experience

Apply Today

If you are an experienced forklift driver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and can thrive in a -20°C freezer, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today, remember to upload your CV. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Servicekoordinator til telte.nu – med ansvar for kvalitet og bemanding
jobs.description:
Kan du skabe overblik, fordele opgaver og sikre, at kvaliteten er i orden? Og trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både koordinerer og selv tager fat? Så er du måske vores nye servicekoordinator hos telte.nu.

Vi søger en struktureret og engageret kollega, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige koordinering i vores serviceafdeling. Du bliver central i at sikre, at medarbejdere, materialer og opgaver hænger sammen, så vi leverer et godt resultat til kunden.

Dine opgaver

Du planlægger dagens arbejde, følger op på opgaverne og hjælper med at få det hele til at fungere i praksis. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og bemanding: Du fordeler medarbejdere og opgaver, så de rette folk er på de rette pladser.

  • Kvalitetskontrol: Du kontrollerer pladser og teltopsætninger og følger op på, at arbejdet lever op til vores standarder.

  • Klargøring og materialer: Du sikrer, at rengøring og kontrol bliver udført grundigt, og at de rigtige materialer bliver leveret.

  • Løbende koordinering: Du tilpasser planen, når behovene ændrer sig, og sørger for, at teamet ved, hvad der skal ske.

  • Praktisk arbejde: Du giver en hånd med på tværs af telte.nu, når der er brug for det.

Hvem er du?

Du sætter en ære i, at udstyret er rent og kontrolleret, at bemandingen er på plads, og at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når der er travlt.

  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og kan sætte retning for dagens opgaver.

  • Har øje for detaljerne og følger op, når noget skal rettes.

  • Tager ansvar og finder løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Trives med at kombinere koordinering med praktiske opgaver.

Erfaring med koordinering, drift, logistik eller lignende opgaver er relevant. Vi vil også gerne høre, hvordan du har skabt overblik og sikret kvalitet i andre sammenhænge.

En vigtig rolle i hverdagen

Hos telte.nu får du en rolle tæt på både teamet og den daglige drift. Din indsats har direkte betydning for, at kollegerne kan løse deres opgaver, og at kunderne får en god oplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV, og fortæl, hvorfor du vil være servicekoordinator hos telte.nu. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description: AML-Palvelut Oy on vuodesta 2002 toiminut perheomisteinen yritys, joka tarjoaa laadukkaita avustaja-, kotihoito- ja sairaanhoitopalveluita. Yritys on sitoutunut tarjoamaan asiakkailleen kokonaisvaltaista hoivaa ja huolenpitoa, ottaen huomioon yksilölliset tarpeet ja toiveet.Tule meille osaava henkilökohtainen avustaja - meillä on tarjota sinulle lämminhenkinen ja sosiaalinen tiimi mukavassa työympäristössä. Etsimme sosiaalisia taitoja omaavaa henkilöä, voit myös olla jo eläkkeellä. Ymmärrämme, että osaaminen ei katso ikää vaan arvostamme monipuolista elämän kokemustasi.Työyhteisömme arvostaa hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja, sillä asiakkaamme ansaitsevat aitoa kohtaamista ja välittämistä. Työaika on päivästä riippuen klo 8-18 välillä. Otamme myös huomioon toiveesi työaikojen suhteen. Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan ja monipuolisen työnkuvan, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen.Jos olet motivoitunut sekä positiivinen, että haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kehittyvää tiimiämme, lähetä meille hakemuksesi CV:n kera osoitteeseen anne.lindholm@amlpalvelut.fi. jobs.title: Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagt
jobs.description:
Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagtHyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

Er du den nattevagt, der kan bringe ro, tryghed og nærvær ind i natten? Brænder du for at skabe de bedste betingelser for trivsel, tryghed og udvikling for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer?

Vi søger en vågen nattevagt til fastansættelse i 7-7 vagtrul til Botilbuddet Vedstedvej. Botilbuddet Vedstedvej er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland, og er et mindre socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor i alt 4 borgere.

Om stillingen:

Stillingen indebærer en helt særlig rolle, hvor du er med til at skabe ro, tryghed, stabilitet og nærvær for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer, når mørket falder på. Borgerne kan til tider have et højt stressniveau, hvor de har behov for at blive rummet og støttet af et roligt nervesystem i en pædagogisk og professionel kontekst.

Du vil indgå i et fast team omkring det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne. Alle medarbejdere indgår på lige fod i dagligdagen, og er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats, hvorfor samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund på bachelorniveau.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til tilbudsleder Mehrdad Zamani, tlf. 40 40 39 24 og mail mez@h-l.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail mez@h-l.dk.

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation.

jobs.title: Private Banker mit einem aufgebauten Kundenbuch
jobs.description:
Unsere Mandantin, ist eine internationale, unabhängige Privatbank im Herzen von Zürich, die sich auf die ganzheitliche Vermögensverwaltung und Anlageberatung spezialisiert hat. Dabei legt sie grossen Wert auf Innovation und Unabhängigkeit in Bezug auf Produktpolitik und deren Selektion. Im Zuge des weiteren Ausbaus, sind wir beauftragt worden, zwei unternehmerische und eigenständige Persönlichkeiten zu gewinnen, als

Private Banker-/ Relationship Manager mit einem aufgebauten Kundenbuch

Als erfolgsorientierter Private Banker überträgt Ihnen unser Kunde die Verantwortung seinen Brand bei Ihrem bestehenden Kundenstamm in einer hohen Komplexität zu präsentieren. Durch profunde Beratung und raschen Vertrauensaufbau entwickeln Sie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, die dem Stile der Bank entsprechen. Högskolan vill nu driva Business Lab vidare med både egna och HÅs samarbetsuniversitets studerande och företag som målgrupper.Som lärare vid HÅ planerar, genomför och utvärderar du undervisningen tillsammans med övriga lärare och andra medarbetare. Du jobbar utgående från moderna högskolepedagogiska principer där ett handledande grepp i relation till de studerande är centralt och digitala lösningar är en del av vardagen. Inom universitetsalliansen EUNICoast kommer du även att verka i ett internationellt sammanhang.Du är bra på att samarbeta och är beredd att som en i ett team stödja i första hand studerande i deras studier men också samarbeta i lärarlag där lärarna stödjer varandra i arbetet. HÅ är en högskola i förändring och det är något du motiveras av. Vid Högskolan på Åland är det inte bara de studerande som ständigt får lära sig nytt utan också medarbetarna, därför behöver du brinna för att också själv utvecklas och förnyas. Som lärare rapporterar du till vicerektor. Vi erbjuder dig ett socialt arbete i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med aktivt tempo i ett engagerat team.**Anställningen delfinansieras med externa medel via EUNICoast.**ARBETSUPPGIFTEREn central arbetsuppgift blir att vidareutveckla konceptet BusinessLab och dess moduler, samt att hålla kurser i entreprenörskap inom alla program på HÅ. Andra uppgifter är att skapa mikromeriter inom den Europeiska universitetsalliansen EUNICoast, som HÅ är en del av. Detta sker i samarbete med externa partners och du kommer att ha möjlighet att verka också internationellt. Att söka framtida finansiering för utveckling av BusinessLab är också en viktig del av arbetet. Aktiv marknadsföring och kommunikation av BusinessLabs verksamhet samt synlighet inom EUNICoast hör till jobbet, detta genom bl.a.sociala medier, deltagande i evenemang, nätverksmöte etc. Under Högskolan på Åland verkar Drivhuset Åland som är en del av Drivhuset Norden. Att inom ramen för Drivhuset Åland inspirera till innovation blir en del av din arbetsbild.Du bidrar till att skapa anställningsbarhet hos studerande som deltar i BusinessLab. Du arbetar också aktivt för att höja konkurrenskraften hos såväl åländska företag som för högskolans studerande som deltar i verksamheten.Arbetet innebär i någon mån resande, främst till våra kustnära partners inom EUNICoast.KOMPETENSER VI SÖKER- Erfarenhet av att driva kuvösverksamhet för den som är intresserad av entreprenörer och företag - Kompetens och erfarenhet av att handleda, stödja och coacha studerande - Förtrogenhet med utbildningsplanering och -design, distanspedagogik och nätbaserat lärande på högskolenivå - Erfarenhet av att söka projektfinansiering - Samarbetsförmåga och vilja att jobba i team, men också förmåga till självständigt arbete t.ex. när det gäller att utveckla regionala, nationella och internationella nätverk - Förändringsberedskap, flexibilitet samt kunskap om förändringsprocesser. Förmåga att engagera och entusiasmera - Förmåga att utveckla entreprenöriellt tänkande hos studeranden samt entreprenöriella förmågor hos företag. - Kommunikationskompetens och digital kompetens i vilken ingår förmåga att kontinuerligt informera om verksamheten i såväl sociala- som traditionella medier samt internt på högskolan. Även att skapa undervisningsmaterial på lärplattformen är en viktig del i jobbet. - Nätverka och representera Högskolan på Åland inom arbetslivet, utbildningssektorn och övriga samarbetspartners både på Åland och utanför Åland - Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande. BEHÖRIGHETSKRAVBehörighetskrav för tjänsten är vid universitet eller därmed jämförbar högskola, som är erkänd av nationell utbildningsmyndighet, avlagd lämplig högre högskoleexamen (EQF-nivå 7). Minst tre års praktisk erfarenhet i uppgifter som motsvarar examen samt yrkeslärarbehörighet eller beredskap att vid sidan av jobbet ta itu med behörighetsgivande studier.VI ERBJUDER DIGSom arbetsgivare är vår högsta prioritet att erbjuda en inspirerande arbetsmiljö där alla medarbetare trivs och mår bra. Vi erbjuder dig ett mångsidigt, socialt arbete i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med aktivt tempo i ett engagerat team. Vid Högskolan på Åland har du möjlighet att utveckla din egen kompetens samt delta i utvecklandet av utbildningsprogrammen. Som anställd får du ta del av många fina förmåner såsom omfattande friskvårdsförmån (motion, kultur och massage), utökad företagshälsovård och lunchförmån. Som lärare vid högskolan har du 12 lediga veckor under året och möjlighet att själv välja tid och plats för ditt arbete under 28% av arbetstiden.LÖNEnligt Årsarbetstidsavtal för Högskolan på ÅlandARBETSTIDArbetstiden är 47,5% av en heltidsanställning som är 1600 h/läsår.

jobs.title: Head of Website & Conversion
jobs.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Head of Website & Conversion to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🔎 Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

 
 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We will never ask for payments or financial information during the recruitment process.

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. jobs.title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

jobs.title: GTM Lead, Europe
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We’re building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn’t just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

Who we are looking for

Everyone at Higgsfield is an A-player. We're looking for teammates who bring:

  • High energy, strong commercial instincts, and flawless execution.

  • Ownership and accountability to drive deals end-to-end.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships with partners, agencies, and enterprise clients.

  • Resilience in high-pressure situations and an always-on mindset.

  • A balance of sharp analytical skills and natural people intuition.

  • Hunger to win and the grit to scale a B2B SaaS business globally.

About the role

This is the GTM Account Executive role for Europe. You will be our first dedicated seller for the region, responsible for turning Europe's agencies, brands, production companies and media groups into Higgsfield customers: sourcing and closing the first European deals yourself and owning the accounts after signature. You work with our Almaty-based GTM team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

What you will work on

  • End-to-end sales execution: identify, pitch, negotiate, and close deals with European agencies, brands and B2B partners, from first touch through signature.

  • Open the market: build a named-account plan for Europe and work it, starting with advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers.

  • Convert platform demand: turn high-usage European creators, teams and agencies already on Higgsfield into team and enterprise accounts.

  • Account management: own relationships post-sale, ensuring adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

  • Partner routes to market: identify and activate European agencies, production studios and resellers that bring us customers we would not reach one deal at a time.

  • Customer success: act as the voice of the European customer internally, ensuring feedback flows into product and engineering.

  • Processes at scale: build the repeatable playbook that the next European hires will follow.

Your must haves

(You don't need to meet every single requirement to be a strong candidate. If you're excellent in a few of these areas and eager to grow, we'd still love to hear from you.)

  • Revenue track record: demonstrable history of consistently achieving and exceeding multi-million dollar revenue targets, with deals you sourced and closed yourself.

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales and/or account management with measurable results.

  • Experience selling into advertising agencies, brand marketing organisations, or media and entertainment companies in at least two European markets.

  • An existing network of senior buyers in European agencies, brands or media groups.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. A second major European language is a strong plus.

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage sales data and metrics for decision-making.

  • Ability to work in a high-growth startup environment.

Nice to haves

  • Big3/Big4 consulting experience or equivalent top-tier professional background is a strong plus.

  • Experience selling AI, GenAI, or ML products.

  • Experience in early-stage, fast-scaling startups.

  • Exposure to upselling, cross-selling, and customer success strategies.

  • Relationships in European broadcasters, streamers or sports media.

  • Existing network of enterprise clients or partners in SaaS/AI ecosystems.

The deal

  • Competitive base salary in USD.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program.

  • Based in Almaty (on-site; we sponsor and process your work permit, cover your flights, and provide temporary housing while you settle in) or remote in Europe, with regular travel across the region and to Almaty.

  • Our GTM team works six days a week and overlaps with US hours. Expect the same pace wherever you are based.

  • Full-time position.

  • Opportunity to become the cornerstone of Higgsfield's European sales engine.

jobs.title: Are you passionate about crisis management, emergency preparedness and building organizational resilience in a global organization?
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Global Security Manager – Crisis Management to strengthen our global security and resilience capability.

In this role, your main responsibility will be crisis management and business continuity, you will work close with our team, and also be involved in a variety of security areas such as personnel security, physical security, information security and travel security. 

You will have a key responsibility for further developing our global approach to crisis management and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with management, security professionals, business units and functions across the organization to ensure that we are prepared to respond effectively when serious incidents occur.The position combines strategic development, governance and hands-on operational crisis management, and requires someone who is comfortable working both proactively and in situations where time, information and predictability may be limited.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve the company’s global Crisis Management framework, including governance, processes, plans and supporting tools.
  • Support and further develop the organization’s Emergency Response and Crisis Management structure globally.
  • Support the establishment and development of local and regional emergency response capabilities, crisis management exercises and training for management teams and relevant functions.
  • Contribute to the broader development of Business Continuity Management and organizational resilience.
  • Together with the Security team you will monitor relevant global developments and emerging risks that may affect our people and operations.
  • Participate in operational crisis response when required, as a important coordinating role in the global crisis management team.
  • Collaborate with the Travel Security Board team. 
We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for! 

What we are looking for:

We believe you have solid experience within crisis management, emergency preparedness, security, resilience or related disciplines, combined with the ability to translate frameworks and requirements into practical solutions.Relevant experience may come from international industry, corporate security, emergency preparedness, defence, police, public authorities or consulting.We are particularly interested in candidates who have:

  • Experience with crisis management and emergency response in a complex organization.
  • Experience developing crisis management plans, frameworks and response structures.
  • Experience planning and facilitating exercises, training and scenario-based crisis management activities.
  • Experience supporting management during serious incidents or crises.
  • Strong understanding of crisis leadership, decision-making and coordination under pressure.
  • Ability to work across organizational, geographical and cultural boundaries.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international organization with global operations will be considered an advantage.Knowledge of recognized standards and good practices within crisis management and business continuity, including ISO 22301 and ISO 27001, will also be beneficial. 

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment. Personal qualitiesTo succeed in this role, you are structured and analytical, while also being pragmatic and operational when the situation requires it.You:
  • remain calm and focused in demanding situations;
  • are comfortable making progress when information is incomplete;
  • communicate clearly with both management and operational teams;
  • build trust and strong professional relationships;
  • take initiative and drive improvement;
  • are curious and continuously look for ways to strengthen preparedness;
  • understand that effective crisis management is ultimately about people, leadership, preparation and the ability to act.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling when required.

Why join us?

Serious incidents rarely follow the plan. - Good crisis management therefore depends not only on having procedures in place, but on having an organization that is prepared, trained and capable of making good decisions when it matters most.As Global Security Manager – Crisis Management, you will have the opportunity to influence how a global organization prepares for and responds to critical events, working across countries, functions and management levels.You will be part of a professional security environment where preparedness, learning and continuous improvement are important elements in protecting our people, operations and business. 

 Work location:Any of Kongsberg Maritimes locations in Norway, though Kongsberg, Horten or Lysaker is preferred.We are flexible on working arrangements. Point of contact:Hanne Marit SchultzDirector Security & Crisis ManagementTel: +47 913 42 479 Link til søknadsskjema: Send application

jobs.title: Servicemedarbejder med håndværksmæssig baggrund
jobs.description:
Servicemedarbejder med håndværksmæssig baggrund

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

 

Har du lyst til en varieret arbejdsdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver? Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for det, du går i gang med? Og trives du i en hverdag, hvor tingene ikke altid er ens, men hvor kvaliteten altid er i orden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

 

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder med stærke håndværksmæssige kompetencer og en håndværksmæssig baggrund, som har lyst til at blive en del af et mindre team med en uformel tone og et stærkt samarbejde.

 

Du får en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med dine kolleger og hvor opgaverne løses på tværs af vores afdelinger

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

 

·       Løsning af håndværksmæssige opgaver i hverdagen

·       Mindre og større vedligeholdelsesopgaver inde og ude

·       Småreparationer og ad hoc-opgaver

·       Sikre, at bygninger og omgivelser fremstår pæne og fungerer optimalt

·       Planlægning og gennemførelse af opgaver med fokus på kvalitet og deadlines

 

Vi forestiller os, at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller relevant erfaring, arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Du trives i et mindre team, bidrager til det gode samarbejde og kan begå dig i en hverdag med beboere med forskellige udfordringer. Du møder mennesker med ro og respekt, er fleksibel i din tilgang til opgaverne og har en naturlig sans for kvalitet og ordentlighed i det, du laver. Du har kørekort B og kan betjene computere, mails og app’s på brugerniveau.

 

Hos os får du:

·       En alsidig hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens

·       Fleksible arbejdsforhold og stor grad af selvstændighed

·       Firmabil til rådighed i arbejdstiden

·       En grundig introduktion, så du kommer godt fra start

·       Fokus på arbejdsglæde, trivsel og udvikling

·       Sundhedsforsikring som en del af ansættelsen

·       Der stilles arbejdsbil med værktøj til rådighed

 

Praktisk

Du vil primært varetage opgaver i vores afdelinger primært på Vestegnen Sjælland, men du kan også forvente at hjælpe i vores øvrige afdelinger, når der er behov.

 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår aftales individuelt.

 

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt - vi venter gerne på den rette.

 

Vil du med på holdet?

 

Så send din ansøgning og CV allerede i dag.

 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

 

Har du yderligere spørgsmål, så ring gerne til driftschef Julie Kragsaa, tlf. 40 40 29 79.

 

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail juk@h-l.dk

 

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation. Du kan læse meget mere om os HER.

 

Kørekort: B (Almindelig bil)

 

Der er 1 ledig stilling

skiftende arbejdstider

Danmark
