jobs.title: PhD Candidate - Hydrogen and Industrial Decarbonization Pathways
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We invite applications for a 3-year PhD Candidate position on the future role of hydrogen and hydrogen products in industrial decarbonization. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT) is to carry out education, research, and innovation activities at an international level at the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE. The department’s activities aim to contribute to sustainable value creation within technology-based areas in industry, business, and the public sector in Norway

 

About the position

Electrification is widely promoted as a key pathway to industrial decarbonization. At the same time, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage (CCS) are increasingly recognized as important solutions for sectors where direct electrification may be difficult or uneconomic. This has led to a growing debate about the future role of "electrons versus molecules" in a net-zero economy.

Most existing studies assume that today's industrial structure remains largely unchanged and focus on how current industries can reduce emissions. However, deep decarbonization may fundamentally reshape industrial production, value chains, competitiveness, and the location of energy-intensive activities. As a result, future hydrogen demand may depend as much on industrial transformation as on technological choices.

This PhD project will investigate how alternative pathways toward a zero-emission industrial sector affect the future demand for hydrogen and the development of hydrogen value chains. The research will analyze the interplay between electrification, hydrogen, and CCS, while explicitly accounting for potential changes in industrial structures and production systems.

 

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How will future hydrogen demand vary across alternative industrial decarbonization pathways?
  • Which industrial sectors are likely to rely on electrification, hydrogen, or CCS to achieve net-zero emissions?
  • How might industrial transformation affect hydrogen production, transport, storage, and trade?
  • What level of hydrogen deployment is required to justify dedicated hydrogen infrastructure and markets?
  • How can Europe and Norway prepare for different industrial and energy-system transition pathways?

 

The successful candidate will develop and analyze future scenarios for industrial transformation, hydrogen demand, and infrastructure development. The project will contribute to the scientific and policy debate on how competitive zero-emission industries can emerge under different transition strategies.

Research environment

The PhD candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment at the intersection of energy economics, industrial economics, operations research, and energy systems analysis.

The position is affiliated with FME HYDROGENi, the Norwegian Research and Innovation Centre for Hydrogen and Ammonia. The centre brings together 46 research and industry partners to develop the knowledge, technologies, and solutions needed to support a sustainable hydrogen economy and contribute to Norway's ambitions for climate neutrality and industrial transformation. FME HYDROGENi conducts research across the hydrogen value chain, including hydrogen production, transport and storage, industrial and maritime applications, safety, and the broader role of hydrogen in future energy systems. The centre is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Centres for Environment-friendly Energy Research (FME) programme and operates during the period 2022-2030

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project

The PhD candidate will:

  • Conduct original scientific research on hydrogen and industrial decarbonization pathways.
  • Develop and analyze scenarios for industrial transformation and climate neutrality.
  • Assess the future role of electrification, hydrogen, and CCS across industrial sectors.
  • Quantify hydrogen demand and infrastructure requirements under alternative transition pathways.
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences.
  • Collaborate with academic, industry, and public-sector partners.
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme.
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research findings.

 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU’s grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:

  • Operations research or optimization
  • Energy systems
  • Energy Economics
  • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Or other closely related disciplines.

Applicants must demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with energy system modelling, scenario analysis, or techno-economic analysis.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen technologies, industrial decarbonization, or climate policy.
  • Experience with quantitative modelling and data analysis.
  • Programming skills in Python, Julia, R, GAMS, or similar tools.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of technology, economics, and policy.

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in an interdisciplinary research environment. 
  • Is interested in research with relevance for industry, policy, and society.

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Close collaboration with leading researchers in energy systems modelling, optimization, and something else 
  • Opportunities to engage with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in research addressing key challenges of the green transition.
  • Opportunities for international research stays and conference participation.
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU 

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

 

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of at least two potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI).  

If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.  

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates.  

NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public applicant list with names, ages, job titles, and municipalities of residence will be prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to reserve yourself from being included on the public applicant list, this must be justified. The assessment will be made in accordance with applicable laws. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is Norway's technology capital with a population of over 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens, and general equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized childcare is readily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers excellent educational opportunities (including international schools) and opportunities to enjoy nature, culture, and family life, with low crime rates and clean air quality.

jobs.title: Kiinteistönhoitajaksi Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietarille
jobs.description: Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari etsii aktiivisen työotteen ja palveluasenteen omaavaa, ammattitaitoista kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Valittava henkilö tulee hoitamaan nimettyjen asuntokohteiden kiinteistönhoitajan tehtäviä. Tehtävän keskeinen sisältö alla:A. Palkkaus: Kiinteistöhoitajan mediaanipalkka on noin 2.500 euroa/kk (keskiarvo on palkkatilaston mukaan noin 2.785 euroa/kk). Palkka tarkentuu valittavan henkilön koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Jos henkilö osallistuu päivystystehtäviin, maksetaan päivystämisestä erilliskorvaus TESin mukaisesti (varallaolo ja ylityöt).B. Noudatettava työehtosopimus: Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimus, jossa palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuusluokan (PR-ryhmät 1–10) mukaan. Kajaanin Pietarilla työntekijöillä on ns. pitkät lomat, eli lomaa kuluu 5 arkipäivää/viikko (muutoin yksityissektorilla 5+1 päivää/viikko).C. Tehtävään vaadittava koulutus: Puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan perustutkinto, jonka laajuus on 180 osaamispistettä ja kesto yleensä 2–3 vuotta. Tai vastaava koulutus.D. Osaamisvaateet: LVI-järjestelmien (lämmitys, vesi, ilmanvaihto) kunnossapito ja seuranta; huolto- ja korjaustyöt = rakennustekniset korjaukset, koneiden käyttö ja pienehköt kunnossapitotyöt; ulkoalueiden hoito: piha-alueiden puhtaanapito, käsilumityöt; asiakaspalvelu = asukkaiden ja kiinteistön käyttäjien opastus (edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja); IT-taidot (toimisto-ohjelmien ja huoltokirjan (Tampuuri) käyttö.E. Ajokortti ja valmius oman auton käyttöön: Tehtävä sisältää työajoja Kajaanin kaupungin alueelle sijaitsevien asuntokohteiden välillä päivisin. Työajoista maksetaan kilometrikorvaus verottajan hyväksymien ohjeiden mukaisesti.Tästä paikasta on julkaistu RekryAreena-lähetys. Pääset katsomaan lähetyksen täältä:https://rekryareena.fi/kiinteistonhoitaja-kajaanin-pietarille/Yhtiö tarjoaa työntekijöilleen laajat työterveyspalvelut, virkistyssetelin (E-passi) 200 euroa (vuonna 2026), kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia soveltuvin osin sekä asianmukaiset työvaatteet. Kiinteistönhoitajalla on selkeät kohdevastuut. Teet työtä mukavien työkavereiden kanssa ja sinulle on esimiehenä nimetty kiinteistöhoidon työnjohtaja. Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari on savuton työpaikka ja 1.10.2026 alkaen noudatamme tupakkalain 2026 määräyksiä kaikissa asuntokohteissamme.Tervetuloa mukaan tekemään tärkeätä työtä kohtuuhintaisen asumisen parissa Kajaanissa! Ryhdymme käymään läpi saapuneita hakemuksia heti! Kerro meille hakemuksessasi, miksi juuri sinä olet hakemamme henkilö ja mitä osaamista tarjoat meille.

jobs.title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement (6 mois) - F/H - Nantes
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

 

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

Vos missions : 

Vous serez support au pilotage et à l'animation d'études d'impacts sur l'environnement de parcs éoliens et centrales solaires comprenant notamment le volet naturel, le volet paysager et des études spécifiques.  

Vous serez en lien avec l'équipe projet, les autorités et les spécialistes pour identifier et traiter l'ensemble des risques environnementaux des projets. 

Vous participerez à la concertation de tous les acteurs permettant de réaliser la conception de projets la plus adaptée au territoire.  

Vous proposerez des axes d'amélioration sur les mesures E-R-C-A (Eviter, Réduire, Compenser, Accompagner) des projets éoliens et solaires. 

En particulier les axes d'amélioration suivants ont été identifiés :  

  • Amélioration du bilan carbone des projets (outils, méthodologies) et proposition de mesures de réduction de l’impact carbone des projets. 
  • Amélioration de la gestion des risques dans les projets solaires développés en SIS (sites et sols pollués). 
  • Amélioration de la synergie entre projets solaires et stockage batterie-BESS (projets d’hybridation). 

Vous participerez au dépôt des dossiers de demande de permis de construire et à leurs instructions (Commission CDPENAF, Enquête Publique, Réponse avis MRAe,...). 

Vous aurez l'occasion de suivre la mise en place concrète de mesures environnementales en phase chantier/construction sur une centrale solaire. 

HSE : 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

Qualité : 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil : 

  •  Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable 
  • Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale. 
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel.   

 

Localisation et déplacements 

Durée : 6 mois  

Localisation : Nantes - déplacements ponctuels en Bretagne / Pays de la Loire / Centre Val de Loire 

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs  
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité   
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (H/F)
jobs.description: Description du poste Spécialisés dans le recrutement des profils qualifiés et experts, People Solutions by Arhis propose un accompagnement sur-mesure pour votre évolution professionnelle. Nous travaillons avec des entreprises de secteurs variés (banque, assurance, industrie, services) qui recherchent des talents comme vous. Chez People Solutions by Arhis, nous savons que chaque parcours est unique. C'est pourquoi nous mettons notre expertise en recrutement au service de votre projet professionnel, en vous proposant un accompagnement personnalisé et attentif pour trouver l'opportunité qui correspond réellement à vos aspirations. Nous recherchons pour un de nos clients, un.e : Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office CDI / Banque / Luxembourg NOTRE CLIENT Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office. A PROPOS DU POSTE Vous avez déjà acquis une premier/ière expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ? Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant. Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels. Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office. Il s'agit d'une fonction particulier/ièrement intéressant/ante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office. VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES: Executive Support & organisation Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif : gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ; organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ; préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ; anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ; coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ; gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés. Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions. Business Management & coordination Une partie important/ante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office. À ce titre, vous : assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ; sollicitez les différentes parties prenant/antes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ; consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ; structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ; maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ; contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ; identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulier/ière et les faites remonter de manier/ière proactive. Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence. Executive Communication & préparation de supports Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif : préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ; préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ; consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ; rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ; préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance. Vous savez transformer une quantité important/ante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision. Coordination & stakeholder management Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes. Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents. La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction. Profil recherché Vous avez idéalement : un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou...

jobs.description:
• Riadenie hnacích vozidiel na vlečke.
• Vykonávanie obsluhu lokomotívy na vlečke.

• Povinnosť dodržiavať všeobecné bezpečnostné a protipožiarne predpisy, v prípade požiaru akéhokoľvek druhu je povinný tento zahlásiť, príp. privolať požiarnikov.

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.description:
🚀 About lemlist

lemlist is a global B2B SaaS business with the mission to help any business grow.

We are doing over $54M in ARR while being:

  • Bootstrapped

  • Profitable

  • A small, agile team of 170 highly talented people, remote-friendly

  • Majority owned by an entrepreneur, Guillaume Moubeche, Founder & Chairman — which gives us maximum freedom

We operate 2 business lines:

  • Sales Engagement with our flagship products lemlist & Claap, generating $58M ARR and growing over 50% year over year

  • Personal Branding with Taplio & Tweet Hunter, generating $4M ARR

lemlist is a highly ambitious company that aims to become a world-class giant in the Sales Tech space.

Our mantra: Keep growing – and we live by it every day.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack TypeScript Developer to join our team. You'll be responsible for designing and developing new features for our SaaS products. We need someone who is passionate, autonomous, and loves technical challenges.

Your main missions will be:

  • Design and develop new features from scratch, both on the frontend and backend, Independently developing new features that enhance user experience and increase product functionality.

  • Stepping into the role of technical lead within your squad, driving excellence and setting standards.

  • Improve the code base with refactoring, bug fixes, and optimization

  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously

  • Help the customer support team on technical issues, providing prompt and effective solutions

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing and capacity building by training fellow developers, enhancing overall team competency and productivity.

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

  • Successfully onboarded and integrated into the team

  • Developed a deep understanding of our B2B SaaS products and their technical requirements

  • Contributed to the development of new features and improvements to our existing code base

Within 12 months you will have

  • Played a key role in the development and delivery of multiple successful projects

  • Made significant contributions to the optimization and scalability of our software products

What’s in it for you?

  • Work in a profitable, bootstrapped, and high-growth company that doesn’t rely on external funding to live.

  • You will have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on a suite of products that are changing the game in multiple industries.

  • Work with passionate senior engineers who share their knowledge and expertise

  • Great ownership of your work. You will be part of a dynamic, innovative, and passionate team that respects autonomy and encourages individual input.

  • No endless meetings

  • Full remote policy

  • You will grow professionally and personally, enhancing your technical skills and expanding your global network.

Preferred Experience

Must have

  • You’re an expert in TypeScript / JavaScript with at least 7 years of XP

  • You have a proven track record in building and maintaining web applications.

  • You have a robust understanding of NodeJS and MongoDB, and ideally React

  • You’re able to work independently and take ownership of complex projects

  • You’re a fast learner

  • You’re comfortable with the agile methodologies

  • You like to communicate

  • You like to work remotely, Gather, Slack and Notion are your best friends

  • You are adaptable and like to discover new things and you can work on front-end integration, back-end development, mongo optimization, performance issues and more

  • You speak French and English and you are in the French timezone

Nice to have

  • You have a first experience in B2B SaaS startup

  • You are self-taught, you have been developing personal projects since you were a child or in the evenings and weekends. This is not mandatory but a big plus for us, we are all passionate about programming and like to create things, both at work and outside

Additional Information

  • Salary between 65K€ and 75K€ fixed salary

  • Profit sharing: When lempire wins, all team members share the profits

  • Where you live, and work is totally up to you – we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

  • Alan Blue: Comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family

  • Swile Meal Tickets: Enjoy daily meal tickets to fuel productivity

  • Navigo Card: Seamless commuting with a 100% covered Navigo card

  • Full-remote Work Setup: A well-funded home office budget to ensure seamless remote work

  • Gear: Get a 48GB Macbook Pro + tools and equipment you need for your job

  • Team building: We all meet once per year at really cool places around the world (you can check our video here ;)

Recruitment process

  • Interview with Lucas our TAM

  • Technical interview with Corentin, our VP of Engineering

  • Technical Interview with Mickael, our CTO

  • Interview with Charles, our CEO

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.title: Hoger Veiligheidskundige
jobs.description: Als HVK’er ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en borgen van veiligheid binnen een complexe industriële productieomgeving. Je vertaalt wet- en regelgeving en relevante normen naar praktisch en werkbaar veiligheidsbeleid. Je hebt een adviserende rol richting het management en verschillende stakeholders en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor veiligheidsvraagstukken. Onderwerpen als Seveso, ATEX en ISO 45001 maken een belangrijk onderdeel uit van je werk. Je analyseert regelgeving en juridische stukken en vertaalt deze naar beleid, standaarden en praktische toepassingen binnen de organisatie. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de plantmanager. Vanuit de veiligheidsorganisatie werk je naast de lijnorganisatie en adviseer en ondersteun je collega's bij het toepassen en verder ontwikkelen van het veiligheidsbeleid. Daarnaast houd je je bezig met onder andere: Vertalen van wet- en regelgeving en normen naar veiligheidsbeleid; Adviseren van management en stakeholders over veiligheidsvraagstukken; Samenwerken met externe partijen, zoals milieudiensten, Seveso-inspectieteams en de arbeidsinspectie; Deelnemen aan veiligheidsprocessen zoals Management of Change (MOC) en Root Cause Analysis (RCA); Ondersteunen bij incidentanalyses en het opvolgen van onveilige situaties en (bijna-)incidenten; Stimuleren van kennisdeling en veiligheidsbewustzijn binnen de organisatie; Opstellen, ontwikkelen en uitwerken van veiligheidsstandaarden. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek en afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring bieden we: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €5.200,- en €7.000,- o.b.v. 36 uur; Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met een werknemersbijdrage van 3%; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%; 25 vakantiedagen; 23 ADV-dagen, die je kunt opnemen of (deels) kunt laten uitbetalen; Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de geldende cao. Wat levert deze baan jou op? In deze functie krijg je de mogelijkheid om vanuit jouw veiligheidskennis daadwerkelijk invloed uit teoefenen op het beleid en de manier waarop veiligheid binnen de organisatie wordt vormgegeven. Je werkt in een industriële omgeving waarin verschillende veiligheidsvraagstukken samenkomen. Hierdoor is je werk inhoudelijk veelzijdig en heb je contact met verschillende disciplines en stakeholders. Je krijgt bovendien een duidelijke adviesrol richting het management en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de plantmanager. Daarmee krijg je de ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise mee te denken over veiligheidsbeleid en de verdere ontwikkeling daarvan. Functie-eisen Voor deze functie zoeken we een ervaren HVK’er die inhoudelijke kennis weet te combineren met een adviserende rol. Je beschikt over: Een HVK-diploma; Ruime ervaring binnen veiligheid in een industriële werkomgeving; Kennis van veiligheidsbeheerssystemen, BRZO/Seveso, ATEX en ISO 45001; Ervaring met het opstellen, ontwikkelen en uitwerken van veiligheidsstandaarden; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders te schakelen; Een kritische, proactieve en resultaatgerichte werkhouding; Een nauwkeurige manier van werken; Organisatiesensitiviteit en het vermogen om veiligheid ook vanuit een strategisch perspectief te bekijken Hier kom je te werken e gaat aan de slag binnen een grote industriële productieomgeving waar dagelijks verschillende technische en veiligheidsvraagstukken samenkomen. Binnen de fabriek wordt gewerkt met onder andere gevaarlijke stoffen en installaties waarbij ATEX-, Seveso- en procesveiligheidsaspecten een belangrijke rol spelen. Veiligheid is binnen de organisatie niet alleen een verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsafdeling. Er wordt gewerkt aan een cultuur waarin veilig werken onderdeel is van het dagelijkse werk en waarin medewerkers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun eigen veiligheid en die van anderen. De veiligheidsorganisatie heeft hierin een adviserende en ondersteunende positie en werkt nauw samen met verschillende onderdelen

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it.

Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds
  • Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed a team of engineers before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Years of hands-on experience designing and running distributed systems, including time spent maintaining what you designed. You can still carry an architecture discussion and review a design, and your team would trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You set the bar for AI adoption on your team. You use it to real effect in your own work, you're honest about where it helped and where it fell short, and you're the first to try new tools, bringing the ones that stick to your engineers.

    • Nice to have
  • You are eager to scale your experience beyond your team - to create wider organisational impact
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS

    • Our stack
  • TypeScript across the board, running on AWS with infrastructure as code, in a single monorepo.

    • None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • HOW WE HIRE

    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

    • Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    • Code Review. You review a feature with two of our engineers.
    • System Design. An architecture problem close to what we deal with.
    • Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    • Meet the Founder.

    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

    ABOUT INSIFY

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.

    •  


    Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

 - Operationalize the pre-work, certifications, and continued learning path so assignments land at the right time and reinforce on-the-job performance

 - Measure onboarding effectiveness through qualitative inputs (e.g., surveys), and translate insights into clear recommendations and iteration plans

 - Create engaging, multimodal learning experiences (AI-assisted content, short-form video, podcasts, and activity-based materials) that help sellers succeed in their segment and reach their full potential with Notion

 - Embed and reinforce Notion’s culture, product value, and customer-first mindset across all field enablement programs

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4+ years of SaaS sales experience

     - 2+ years full cycle selling

 - Demonstrate agency to lead enablement within team

 - Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and stakeholder management abilities

 - Proficiency and ability to coach proven sales methodologies, including MEDDPICC, core sales competencies, and Command of the Message with practicality

 - Self-motivated problem solver who excels in ambiguous situations and takes complete ownership of projects

 - Creative thinker able to build engaging, outcome-focused content that drives behavioral change

 - Coaching mindset with high empathy for new hires and current sellers, driving effective change by challenging perspectives and focusing the team on value-based conversations

 - Proactive by nature, takes decisive action when identifying skill gaps or risks that could impact the success of enablement initiatives

 - Culture carrier, with a strong ability and desire to roll up their sleeves and make an impact in a high-growth environment

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level in English

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Fluency in Korean
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Head of Insurance Supply
jobs.description:
🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business.

Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team.


What you’ll do:

1. Build and diversify our capacity panel

  • Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
  • Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers.
  • Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement.
  • Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year.
  • Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.

    •  

    2. Build strong carrier partnerships

  • Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level.
  • Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations.
  • Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels.
  • Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time.
  • Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.

    •  

    3. Shape products and build the function

  • Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products.
  • Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications.
  • Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution.
  • Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting.
  • Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk.
  • Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows.

    • What you’ll bring:
  • At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier.
  • A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers.
  • A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications.
  • Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market.
  • The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail.
  • Fluent English.

    • Strong advantage:
  • Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures.
  • Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z.
  • Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment.
  • German or French proficiency.
  • Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function.
    • If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you.
    🤝 What we offer in return:
    🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions.
    💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office.
    🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home.
    🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office.
    ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to.
    🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually
    ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy.
    🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams.
    ✈️  Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues.
    🚂  Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office.
    🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life.
    ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).
     
    🏁 Our recruitment process
    We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:
     
    Step 1 - Your motivation
    To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team.
    Step 2 - Role fit
    In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager.
    Step 3 - Case study
    For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities.
    Step 4 - Our culture connect
    Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.
     
    Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you!
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance.
    At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us.
    With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together.
    Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity.
