jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  (H/F)
jobs.description: L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements, 1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité - nous recherchons un**-**e Software Engineer senior aussi bien à l'aise avec Django que React pour nous aider à accélérer, se connecter à plus de fabricants et améliorer l'impact de l'application. Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.Tes missions :- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateformeProfil recherchéÀ l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.Compétences clés recherchées :- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipeCompétences techniques recherchées :- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métieAutres compétences recherchées :- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact- Goût pour les belles choses- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflowsEnvironnement technique:Backend- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)- Orchestration de taches: Celery- Cache : RedisFrontend Web- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript- Framework: ReactJs- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natifBase de Données- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles- NoSQL : MongoDB pour la gestion de données semi-structurées / documentsInfrastructure & Déploiement- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisésOutils & Collaboration- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)- Documentation : Slite- Contrôle de version : GitLabTu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !Nos valeurs :- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.- User focused : à l'écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de nos services et de nos produits.- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l'humilité et l'honnêteté.

Et praktisk deltidsjob med klare rammer – 7 timer om ugen i 8210 Aarhus V
jobs.description:
Et praktisk deltidsjob med klare rammer – 7 timer om ugen i Præstehaven, 8210 Aarhus V 

Kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt, være fysisk aktiv og se resultatet af din indsats? 

Hvidbjerg Service ApS søger en stabil og engageret kollega til trappevask af 10 opgange i boligområdet Præstehaven. Præstehaven er et etableret boligområde i Hasle i Aarhus V.  

Stillingen er på 7 timer om ugen, som eventuelt kan fordeles på to vagter efter aftale. Det kan være et godt match for dig, der søger et mindre deltidsjob ved siden af studie, andet arbejde eller en hverdag med plads til nogle aktive timer. På sigt er der mulighed for flere timer hos nogle af vores andre kunder (kontorrengøring) 

Du får en tydelig opgave og en god start 

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med rengøring. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring, så du ved, hvad du skal gøre, hvordan du gør det, og hvornår opgaven er løst godt. 

Du får: 

  • En fast plan for de 10 opgange 

  • En enkel digital tjekliste på din telefon 

  • Grundig oplæring, inden du arbejder alene 

  • Det rigtige udstyr og de rigtige rengøringsmidler 

  • En kontaktperson, du kan få hjælp fra 

  • Ansvar for at køre driften ved Præstehaven selv 

  • Et stille og roligt job, hvor du går for dig selv 

Hvem er du? 

Det vigtigste er, at du: 

  • Møder stabilt og til tiden 

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde 

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og følge en plan 

  • Har sans for, når noget er gjort ordentligt 

  • Tager ansvar for dine opgaver 

Det praktiske 

Arbejdssted: Præstehaven, 8210 Aarhus V 

Opgave: Trappevask af 10 opgange 

Timetal: 7 timer om ugen - mulighed for flere timer hos nogle af vores andre kunder (kontorrengøring) 

Arbejdstid: Eventuelt fordelt på to vagter – aftales nærmere.  Dagtimer i hverdage eller weekender

Opstart: 1. December 

Din indsats kan ses og mærkes 

En ren og velholdt opgang gør en forskel for de beboere, der bruger den hver dag. Hos os får du et praktisk arbejde med tydelige opgaver, frihed under ansvar og et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Du bliver vores faste medarbejder i Præstehaven og får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige rengøring og drift hos kunden. Du har selvfølgelig en fast kontaktperson, som du altid kan kontakte, hvis du har spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp. 

Om os: 

Hvidbjerg Service ApS er en rengøringsvirksomhed, der arbejder i Aarhus og omegn. Virksomheden tilbyder blandt andet kontor- og erhvervsrengøring, vinduespolering, trappevask og rengøring af fællesområder i boligforeninger.  

Hos Hvidbjerg Service ApS arbejder vi for at skabe rene og velholdte omgivelser, som kunder og beboere kan glæde sig over hver dag. Vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, stabile aftaler og medarbejdere, der tager ansvar og er stolte af deres arbejde.  

Som medarbejder får du grundig oplæring, tydelige opgaver og frihed til at arbejde selvstændigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når du har de rette rammer og nem adgang til hjælp og sparring. 

 

Er det dig, vi leder efter? 

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller: 

  • Hvem du er 

  • Hvornår på ugen du kan arbejde 

  • Hvornår du kan starte 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

jobs.title: HSE Manager (h/f)
jobs.description:
📜 Contexte

Pour le compte d'un groupe industriel international spécialisé dans les secteurs des parfums, des arômes, de la beauté et du bien-être, nous recherchons un(e) EHS Manager pour intervenir sur un site de production situé dans le canton de Genève.

Rattaché(e) à la Direction EHS, vous serez responsable du pilotage des activités Environnement, Hygiène et Sécurité du site, avec pour objectifs de garantir la conformité réglementaire, maîtriser les risques industriels et développer une véritable culture sécurité auprès des équipes.

📌 Votre rôle

Vous pilotez la stratégie EHS du site et accompagnez les équipes opérationnelles dans l'application des exigences de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement.

Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la prévention des risques, la sécurité des procédés industriels et l'amélioration continue des pratiques EHS.

🎯 Missions

🔹 Pilotage EHS & management

  • Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site en accord avec les standards du groupe.

  • Conseiller la direction et accompagner les managers opérationnels.

  • Développer la culture sécurité et sensibiliser les collaborateurs.

  • Superviser les formations EHS et les programmes de prévention.

🔹 Sécurité & conformité

  • Garantir le respect des réglementations suisses en matière d'EHS.

  • Piloter les audits, analyser les incidents et définir les actions correctives.

  • Suivre les KPI EHS et assurer le reporting réglementaire.

  • Superviser la gestion des déchets et les plans d'urgence.

🔹 Process Safety & gestion des risques

  • Piloter les initiatives de Process Safety Management (PSM).

  • Identifier et évaluer les risques liés aux procédés industriels.

  • Garantir la conformité aux exigences ATEX.

  • Collaborer avec les spécialistes pour réduire les risques industriels.

💼 Votre profil

  • Master en ingénierie, chimie, EHS ou domaine équivalent.

  • 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en environnement industriel.

  • Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en management d'équipe.

  • Expérience confirmée en EHS sur un site de production.

  • Maîtrise du Process Safety Management et des réglementations ATEX.

  • Diplôme suisse d'expert STPS requis.

  • Certification de chargé(e) de sécurité incendie : un atout.

  • Compétences en analyse des risques, audits et gestion des incidents.

  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.

  • Bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office.

🏆 Conditions du poste

  • 📍 Localisation : Canton de Genève, Suisse

  • 🕒 Taux d'occupation : 100 %

  • 📅 Démarrage : À convenir

  • 💼 Environnement : Industriel international

💥 Le processus de recrutement

Le processus ENOVA se déroule généralement en plusieurs étapes :

  • Un premier entretien en visioconférence (Teams) pour échanger sur votre parcours et vous présenter ENOVA.

  • Un second entretien avec un manager ENOVA.

  • Un entretien avec les équipes techniques du client.

  • Un dernier échange pour formaliser la collaboration.

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre ENOVA ?

  • Participer à des projets stimulants dans des environnements industriels internationaux.

  • Intervenir sur des enjeux stratégiques de sécurité et de prévention des risques.

  • Évoluer dans des environnements techniques exigeants et innovants.

  • Bénéficier d'un management de proximité et d'un accompagnement personnalisé.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Experimental Clearance Flow Research - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
The PhD candidate will, as part of a collaboration project between a private enterprise and DTU Construct, carry out experimental clearance flow research with ammonia and other sustainable marine fuels. Pressure and temperature conditions, resembling those in a marine engine booster pump, are created in an in-house designed clearance flow test rig. Measured clearance flow data will be used to develop and validate accurate flow models. The test rig will be further modified to enable testing and evaluation of different sealing solutions.Responsibilities and qualificationsThe PhD candidate will be responsible for continuing our development of a high-pressure ammonia flow rig, conduct test campaigns with different ammonia pump components and develop both theoretical and experimental foundation for developing ammonia compatible sealing techniques.The candidate should have significant experience with:
  • Safe handling of ammonia and other liquified gases in test setups.
  • Design and wiring electronic data acquisition and control systems using PC Schematics.
  • LabView programming.
  • Mechanical design and FEM analysis using Solid Works.
  • Data processing of large experimental sets of dynamic flow and pressure data using statistical methods in Matlab.
  • CMM (Coordinate Measurement Machine) measurement and preferably have experience with Calypso Software.
  • Data processing large complex geometric data sets from CMM measurements for 3-dimensional analysis of tested pump components.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and EnrolmentThe scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Anders Ivarsson, aniv@dtu.dk.You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedureYour complete online application must be submitted no later than 19 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Enterprise Account Executive
Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.

More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.

We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 – NOK 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Attractive welfare benefits
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter of maximum one page (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A three-page project description including background/theoretical relevance, research aims, and planned methodological and analytical approaches, in addition to a one-page progress plan. The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Up to three peer-reviewed academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment.

Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
jobs.description:
Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten.

Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten.

Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken.

Jouw rol

Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten.

Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.

Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren.


Wat je doet

Data- en AI-governance

  • Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI.

  • Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming.

  • Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen.

  • Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps.

  • Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten.

Data quality, metadata & AI

  • Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage.

  • Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act.

Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement

  • Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen.

  • Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten.

  • Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren.

  • Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team.

Samenwerking & ontwikkeling

  • Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is.

  • Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid.

  • Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.


Wat jij meebrengt
Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy.

  • Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders.

  • Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT.

  • Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's.

  • Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation.

  • Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks.

  • Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI.

Over ons team

Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie.

We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?
Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

jobs.title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? jobs.title: Salgskonsulent til Diviso
jobs.description:
Hos Diviso mangler vi en erfaren B2B-sælger, der brænder for new business og opsøgende salg.

Du brænder for det opsøgende salg. Det betyder, at du selv afsøger markedet, finder de relevante beslutningstagere og skaber de åbninger, der bliver til langsigtede kunderelationer.

  • Vi rådgiver og udvikler skræddersyede digitale løsninger – alt fra web og apps til komplekse integrationer og platforme. Vi har et stærkt hold, dybe kompetencer og stærke cases i ryggen. Det, vi mangler nu, er dig til at bringe dem i spil hos endnu flere kunder.

  • Mange virksomheder slås dagligt med manuelle arbejdsgange, som stjæler tid fra deres egentlige arbejde. Vi ved, hvordan vi løser det for dem – men vi har brug for din hjælp til at finde virksomhederne og skabe adgangen til de rette folk.

Din opgave er at skabe ny forretning

Det her er ikke en rolle, hvor du får overdraget varme leads. Du får ansvaret for selv at afsøge markedet, finde de rigtige virksomheder og skabe den første kontakt.

Du skal:

  • Identificere relevante virksomheder og finde de rette beslutningstagere

  • Opbygge og drive din egen pipeline

  • Tage den første kontakt – primært over telefonen

  • Afdække kundens behov, udfordringer og ambitioner

  • Kvalificere mulighederne og booke salgsmøderne

  • Drive salgsprocessen og opbygge relationen hele vejen til en aftale

Hvad enten vi leverer en af vores standardløsninger eller bygger noget helt fra bunden, tager vi altid udgangspunkt i kundens virkelighed. For at lykkes i rollen skal du kunne sætte dig i kundens sted, forstå deres udfordringer og hurtigt se, hvor vores digitale løsninger kan skabe reel værdi. Det kræver forretningsforståelse, nysgerrighed og at du er stærk til at åbne døren og opbygge tillid fra første kontakt.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Vi tilbyder en uformel arbejdsplads med god humor og et stærkt sammenhold. Vi har hinandens ryg, tager os tid til at sparre og hjælper dig med at komme godt i mål.

Send din ansøgning og CV via https://jobs.diviso.dk/jobs/8515588-salgskonsulent-til-diviso - så vender vi tilbage til dig ;)

Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt Kristian H. Kristensen på kk@diviso.dk eller på 22996844

jobs.title: Warranty Electrician
jobs.description:
About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

The Role

Join our warranty team delivering troubleshooting, repairs, diagnostics and technical support for train electrical and electronic systems during the warranty period.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform assembly, disassembly, measurement, diagnosis, corrective maintenance, and follow-up of electrical/electronic failures in the various train systems.• Change and replace any type of electrical and electronic element and component of the train.• Carry out and report modifications resulting from the analysis of systematic electrical/electronic failure reports.• Track, accompany, and supervise train systems and their performance.• Load and extract data from diagnostic software, interfaces, and electrical/electronic system tools.• Collaborate with Product Maintenance teams to provide troubleshooting support and technical advice.• Prepare technical reports and documentation of interventions and corrective actions performed.• Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards.• Support root-cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

• Electrical Technician, Electrician, or similar qualification.• Experience in electrical maintenance and troubleshooting.• Ability to read electrical diagrams and technical documentation.• English required.

What We Offer

• International environment• Development opportunities• Competitive conditions• Work with modern railway technology

jobs.title: IT lead
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As IT Lead, you will establish and run Nordscale Operations’ internal IT function in Narvik. As our first internal IT appointment, you will initially focus on hands-on operations and employee support, working closely with our external IT provider. You will also collaborate across functions within the organisation, beyond day-to-day user support.

 

The scope covers internal corporate IT and access to partner systems. As the organisation grows, your responsibility will expand towards IT strategy.

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

  • Run day-to-day IT operations: configure PCs and software, support users, and manage onboarding, accounts, access, and single sign-on across internal and partner systems.
  • Establish IT policies and procedures for cybersecurity, data protection, and business continuity; implement Nscale’s configuration and security requirements with site leadership and external specialists.
  • Manage equipment and software procurement, licences, asset lifecycles, and relationships with IT vendors and service providers.
  • Deliver upgrades, migrations, and technical refreshes; monitor performance, uptime, and user experience; and develop compatible, scalable infrastructure and support services.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may be an experienced IT consultant, systems administrator, or operational IT professional ready to build a function. Experience in or supporting larger organisations with several partners is valuable; previous senior IT leadership experience is not required.

 

You enjoy practical work, connect technical decisions with longer-term business needs, and keep up to date with technology trends.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Self-driven and structured, taking ownership of decisions, priorities, and outcomes.
  • A service-oriented problem-solver who identifies risks and preventive measures.
  • Collaborative across teams and partners, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical colleagues.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid hands-on experience across networks, infrastructure, cloud services, software administration, user support, and account and access management.
  • Good working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance, including implementing policies and procedures.
  • Experience with IT assets, procurement, licences, and vendors, plus upgrades, migrations, and scalable service improvements.
  • Fluent Norwegian and English, written and spoken. Relevant IT management, systems administration, or cybersecurity certification is desirable, not required.

 

What We Can Offer You

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
  • The opportunity to build an internal IT function, combining practical technical work with a path towards broader strategic responsibility.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work. Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye renholder på Karljohansvern?
jobs.description:
Bli en del av Forsvarsbyggs renholdsteam! Vi søker en renholder til fast 50% stilling.

Forsvarsbygg har en stor og profesjonell renholdsorganisasjon med over 400 ansatte, med ansvar for renhold i forsvarssektoren. Dette innebærer alt fra kontorarealer til operative militæranlegg over hele landet. Totalt forvalter vi rundt én million kvadratmeter renholdsareal, noe som gjør oss til en stor aktør i bransjen.

Vi legger stor vekt på kvalitet, struktur og gode rutiner i det daglige arbeidet. Renhold er en viktig del av førstelinjevedlikeholdet i Forsvarsbygg, og som renholder hos oss bidrar du til et trygt, trivelig og funksjonelt miljø for alle som bruker våre bygg og anlegg.

Les mer om Forsvarsbygg på www.forsvarsbygg.no/jobb

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre regelmessig og periodisk renhold, samt rengjøringsrelaterte oppgaver innen eget fagområde
  • Ivaretakelse av oppgaver knyttet til renholdstjenesten
  • Plikter å gjennomføre pålagte kurs i henhold til gjeldende kompetanseplan
  • Samarbeid med andre renholdsleverandører dersom dette er nødvendig
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har en ryddig og strukturert tilnærming til arbeidsoppgavene. Vi skal levere gode renholdstjenester, som stiller krav til at du er opptatt av å levere god kvalitet og samarbeider godt med andre. Hvis du også har gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper, fleksibel og er serviceorientert vil dette kunne være riktig stilling for deg.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du må beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig godt
  • Du må ha førerkort klasse B
  • Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring som renholder
  • Dersom du skal bli tilsatt som renholdsoperatør kreves fagbrev som renholder, hvis du ikke har fagbrev blir du tilsatt som renholdsbetjent
  • Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for nivå Hemmelig og NATO Secret før tiltredelse. Les mer om sikkerhetsklarering på www.nsm.no
    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?

    I Forsvarsbygg vil du få en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag hvor du vil bidra til å bygge forsvarsevne hver dag. Vi satser på medarbeiderne våre, vi tilbyr kursing, etter- og videreutdanning. Vi har en familievennlig og fleksibel personalpolitikk med gode arbeidstidsordninger. Du vil også få tilgang til bedriftsidrettslag med varierte aktiviteter. Som ansatt hos oss får du medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, som er en av landets beste pensjonsordninger med mulighet for boliglån og gode forsikringsordninger.

    Andre opplysninger

    • Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev. For oss er det mer relevant med en beskrivende CV som viser hva du har av erfaring og kompetanse. I stedet ber vi deg svare på noen spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet, og vi setter pris på utfyllende svar.
    • Hvis du har fagbrev som renholdsoperatør blir du tilsatt som renholdsoperatør i stillingskode 1130. Lønn fra kr. 504 500 til kr. 549 100
    • Hvis du ikke har fagbrev blir du tilsatt som renholdsbetjent i stillingskode 1129. Lønn fra kr. 470 100 til kr. 498 100
    • Vi ber om at du laster opp vitnemål og karakterutskrifter i søknaden din
    • Offentlig søkerliste utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge
    KontaktinformasjonAdelheid Eriksen, Renholdsleder distrikt Oslofjord, 97548120 ArbeidsstedNedre vei 22 3183 Horten Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Forsvarsbygg eiendomsforvaltning Renhold Referansenr.: 5202648240 Stillingsprosent: 50% Fast Søknadsfrist: 18.11.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Forsvarsbygg er en etat underlagt Forsvarsdepartementet. Vi bygger, forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder bygg og anlegg som er avgjørende for Norges sikkerhet. Forsvarsbygg er en beredskapsetat, og vi skal levere på vårt oppdrag for Forsvaret i fred, krise og krig. 

    Vi forvalter cirka 13 000 bygg og anlegg, og gjennomfører rundt 700 investeringsprosjekter til enhver tid. Det gjør oss til Norges største offentlige eiendomsaktør. Ansvaret vårt spenner fra historiske festninger åpne for allmennheten til landets mest komplekse og samfunnskritiske forsvarsanlegg.

    Hos oss vil du kunne bidra med din kompetanse til å styrke den norske forsvarsevnen, og gjøre oss mer robust, bærekraftig og framtidsrettet.

    Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.

jobs.title: Make an impact with us at Kongsberg Maritime.
jobs.employer: KONGSBERG MARITIME AS AVD BEKKAJORDET HORTEN
jobs.description:
We're seeking talented individuals to help us shape the maritime future. If you're ready to be part of this exciting journey, your adventure begins here!

The Global HSE Manager – Operational Safety is responsible for developing, maintaining and improving KM’s global approach to operational safety, with emphasis on preventing serious injuries and fatalities, strengthening operational risk management and ensuring effective implementation of operational control requirements across divisions, business units and sites.

The position supports the Global Director HSE in strengthening KM’s operational safety performance, ensuring consistent expectations for high-risk activities, incidents, investigations, learning and corrective actions, and enabling the organisation to manage operational safety risks through clear requirements, practical guidance and effective follow-up.

What you will be doing• Risk Management: Own the HSE Risk Management process, maintain the Global HSE Risk Register, and facilitate risk reviews and assurance activities.• Operational Control: Own the operational control process and coordinate the development, implementation and continuous improvement of global HSE operational controls.• Learning and Improvement: Own the global lessons learned and HSE Subject Matter Expert frameworks and facilitate HSE forums and meetings to strengthen knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.• Safety Culture: Drive Human and Organisational Performance (HOP) initiatives to strengthen KM’s safety culture.• Systems and Tools: Act as system owner, where assigned, for HSE tools and applications, including governance, development, supplier management, budgets and improvement roadmaps.• HSE Assurance and Support: Conduct audits and inspections, lead or support incident investigations, provide subject matter expertise, and deliver HSE training, advice and professional support.

We think you should have• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent relevant experience.• Solid experience with HSE risk management, operational controls and high-risk work activities.• Experience with incident reporting, serious incident investigations, corrective actions and sharing of lessons learned• Good knowledge of ISO 45001 and practical application of HSE management system requirements. Knowledge of ISO 14001 is an advantage• Good business understanding and ability to translate operational safety requirements into practical and effective ways of working• Experience from an operational HSE role is an advantage

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

You are able to• understand the organization's informal rules and structures and utilize political processes effectively to get things done• act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results• make an impact, convince and persuade others and promote plans and ideas successfully• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate your time effectively• demonstrate specialist knowledge and expertise in own area• communicate in a clear, precise and structured way

Why join us• An exciting and important position working for the world-leading supplier of maritime solutions• Be part of a diverse team spread across several countries, embracing collaboration and cultural diversity.• We offer flexible working hours.• We offer hybrid working arrangement.

Kongsberg Maritime’s strength lies in unity. Diverse minds, developing technologies for sustainable oceans, drive innovation worldwide

Where you will be workingAny KM location in Norway, Sweden, Finland, UK or Poland. Other global locations may be considered for strong internal candidates, though Europe is preferred due to time zones.

Interested in knowing more? ContactMagnus Soon ArnhusGlobal Director HSE +47 408 85 376

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Our People and Corporate Affairs Division is a key enabler to the Kongsberg Maritime strategy, unifying the support functions to deliver the business strategy and goals. We are closely connected to the operations and cover a wide breadth of different functions, with common themes of global functional and business support, external relations development, safety, security, people enablement and communications, operational excellence, and license to operate. The division includes People, HSE, Quality, Compliance, Export Control, Facility, Supply Chain, Communication and Public Affairs.

Fasademontører søkes til reiseoppdrag i Gulen

Stillingstittel: Tømrer

Tømrere og montører til prosjekt i Gulen (Bergen)

For kunde søker vi dyktige tømrere for utleieoppdrag i Gulen frem til Påske. Er du praktisk anlagt og glad i arbeid ute?

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Selskapet ble etablert i 2005, og har siden den gang hatt en positiv utvikling i forhold til kunder og oppdrag.
