jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Development Health
Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasksYour work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competenciesYou have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position. 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV). 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and potential PhD diploma). 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications (optional). 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position. 
  • References/recommendations. 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.    

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. Interviews are expected to be held during December 2026

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Senior Web Developer
jobs.description:
Want to help millions of people think better?

reMarkable makes paper tablets for people who think better on paper. Founded in Oslo in 2013, we’ve created a category of our own: distraction-free devices that combine the feel of pen on paper with the power of digital tools. Our products are used by people all over the world to think, focus and do their best work. We design our hardware, software and services in-house, and we’re a focused, high-ownership team where every role has a direct impact on the product and our customers.

You will be part of the Global ecommerce team, which is responsible for delivering an exceptional shopping experience on remarkable.com, our primary sales channel.

As a Senior Web Developer, you’ll play a key role in building and optimizing our eCommerce platform frontend, from customer experience to internal user experience. Embedded in cross-functional product teams and reporting to the Unit lead, you’ll implement modern designs using a contemporary tech stack, contribute to architectural decisions, champion engineering best practices, and mentor other developers.

Your responsibilities may include

  • Working within cross-functional teams, crafting sophisticated design and modern web that directly engage our users and drive business outcomes

  • Leading the development and optimization of new and existing web applications using our cutting-edge stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Sanity, and the latest in modern tooling. You'll be at the forefront of implementing solutions that are performant, scalable and maintainable

  • Improving our architecture by engaging in critical discussions on software architecture, technology selection, and framework adoption, directly influencing the technical roadmap

  • Cultivating engineering culture, lead by example in code quality, and contribute significantly to our CI initiatives

  • Mentoring junior and mid-level developers, help build a collaborative team that thrives on continuous learning and improvement

  • Enhance the efficiency of business users and enable effective tradeoffs across business and technology

  • Drive and impact business results, by optimizing conversion funnels, building new features and improving site performance to directly impact sales and enhance the customer journey

We are looking for candidates with the following experience

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React in medium to large-sized codebases

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS

  • Experience collaborating and communicating within cross-functional teams, including UX and visual designers, test automation engineers, and product managers

It would also be beneficial if you have

  • Relevant experience in eCommerce, including familiarity with eCommerce engines

  • Experience as a full-stack developer

  • Experience with Sanity

  • University degree in computer science or a related field

(Don't meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!)

Why we enjoy working at reMarkable

  • Encouragement to learn and grow in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, learning, and modern technology

  • 5 extra paid “reMarkable days” in addition to regular vacation.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment and towels

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.

Practical information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

jobs.title: Press Brake Operator, Stera Technologies Oy Tammela
jobs.description: We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Press Brake Operator to join our client Stera Technologies Oy in Tammela. However, you may also have gained the required skills through several years of practical work experience. We value a proactive and responsible approach to work as well as a commitment to producing high-quality results safely and efficiently.We offer:- a permanent, full-time position- the opportunity to later transfer to Stera Technologies Oy's own payroll- two-shift work and the opportunity to work in a developing industrial environment- salary in accordance with the Technology Industries collective agreement and your experience, starting from approximately 14€/hour- support from a skilled work community and comprehensive orientation for the roleIn addition, as an Eilakaisla employee, you will have access to comprehensive occupational healthcare services provided by Mehiläinen from your first day of employment. You will also receive thorough guidance on employment-related administrative matters and the support of your dedicated HR consultant throughout your employment.We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For data security reasons, we do not accept applications by email. jobs.title: Servicemedarbejder med ben i næsen og et smil på læben søges – fuldtid
jobs.description:
Har du ben i næsen og et smil på læben? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Københavneren i Helsingør søger en ny kollega på fuldtid!

Er du udadvendt, ansvarsbevidst og god til mennesker? Kan du bevare overblikket, når der er travlt, og møde vores gæster med både humor, varme og et glimt i øjet?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

To verdener under samme tag

Københavneren er ikke helt som andre arbejdspladser.

Om dagen er vi en hyggelig restaurant, hvor vi serverer klassisk dansk smørrebrød og frokostretter til både danske og svenske gæster.

Om aftenen forvandles stedet til et traditionelt, livligt værtshus, hvor fællesskab, gode samtaler og en afslappet atmosfære er i centrum.

Det betyder, at du får en alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige gæster, opgaver og tempo.

Vi søger derfor en person, der både kan levere god restaurantservice om dagen og trives med stemningen og gæsterne på et værtshus om aftenen.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder først og fremmest efter den rette personlighed!

Måske har du arbejdet i restaurant eller bar, men du kan lige så godt komme fra butik, salg, kundeservice eller en helt anden branche og have lyst til at prøve noget nyt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har ben i næsen og tør tage ansvar

  • Er udadvendt, smilende og naturligt god til mennesker

  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Er mødestabil, pålidelig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og træffe beslutninger

  • Kan sætte grænser på en venlig, men bestemt måde

  • Har humor og trives med mange forskellige typer mennesker

  • Er en god kollega, der bidrager til et positivt arbejdsmiljø

  • Er fleksibel og kan arbejde både dag, aften og weekend

Erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi vægter personlighed, ansvarsfølelse og den rette indstilling højere end en bestemt uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af både restaurant- og værtshusdriften, hvor dine opgaver blandt andet omfatter:

  • Tage godt imod gæsterne og sikre god service

  • Servering af mad og drikkevarer

  • Bararbejde og kassebetjening

  • Klargøring, åbning og lukning

  • Holde orden og sørge for, at stedet altid fremstår indbydende

  • Håndtere forskellige situationer professionelt og med godt humør

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en velfungerende hverdag

Du får naturligvis oplæring i vores arbejdsgange.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En fuldtidsstilling med både dag-, aften- og weekendvagter

  • En alsidig arbejdsplads med både restaurant og værtshus

  • Et hyggeligt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

  • Masser af forskellige mennesker og aldrig to helt ens dage

  • Mulighed for ansvar og indflydelse på hverdagen

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Har vi fanget din interesse?

Så send os en kort ansøgning og dit CV til:

Kobenhavneren@outlook.dk

Fortæl gerne lidt om dig selv, din tidligere erfaring, og hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! ❤️

Københavneren ApSSct. Anna Gade 173000 Helsingør

processes, including customer acceptance, new product approvals and the handling of customer complaints • Communicating with and reporting to competent supervisory authorities, including the CSSF Who relating to regulatory and governance requirements for private wealth management in an international setting and asset servicing for regulated investment funds • Sound knowledge of financial products and instruments • In-depth knowledge and understanding of AML/CFT legislation, coupled with previous experience as MLRO • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to set clear jobs.title: tecnico chimico
jobs.description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti sistemi di incentivazione e premi di risultato; Piano Welfare; Mensa aziendale. jobs.title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. jobs.title: RADNIK NA ODRŽAVANJU - ELEKTRIČAR(M/Ž)
jobs.description:
O NAMA

Bjelin Ogulin 2 d.o.o. dio je hrvatsko-švedske Bjelin grupacije, jednog od vodećih europskih proizvođača inovativnih drvenih podova. Usmjereni smo na visokotehnološku proizvodnju i razvoj održivih rješenja od drva, spajajući lokalnu stručnost s globalnim standardima kvalitete. Naš tim čine motivirani i stručni profesionalci različitih profila – od proizvodnih i tehničkih do inženjerskih i stručnih administrativnih funkcija – koje povezuje zajednička strast prema inovacijama, kvaliteti i kontinuiranom unapređenju procesa. Trenutno intenzivno ulažemo u izgradnju najsuvremenijeg pogona za proizvodnju podova u Ogulinu te širimo kapacitete kroz nove proizvodne linije za Woodura podne obloge. Paralelno s razvojem proizvodnje, sustavno jačamo organizaciju kroz razvoj tehničkih, logističkih, administrativnih i ostalih ključnih podržavajućih funkcija. U nadolazećem razdoblju fokusirani smo na zapošljavanje, edukaciju i osposobljavanje zaposlenika svih profila, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke razine kvalitete procesa, proizvoda i održivog rasta cijele organizacije.

TVOJI KLJUČNI ZADACI

  • Održavanje i popravak radnih linija, strojeva i pribora,

  • Remont postrojenja,

  • Vođenje brige o elektroopremi,

  • Obavljanje sitnih popravaka i čišćenja elektro dijelova uređaja,

  • Sudjelovanje u demontaži i montaži elektroopreme prilikom redovitih i interventnih servisa i pri otklanjanju kvarova,

  • Praćenje rada uređaja i strojeva, ukazivanje na trenutne probleme i sudjelovanje u otklanjanju istih,

  • Pregled elektroopreme prema uputama (svakodnevno, tjedno, mjesečno) te ažurira iste.

OČEKUJEMO

  • SSS tehničkog ili drugog odgovarajućeg usmjerenja

  • Interes za otkrivanjem i rješavanjem problema

  • Komunikativna ste i organizirana osoba

  • Orijentiran na detalje i pouzdan zaposlenik

  • Profesionalizam, želju za učenjem i uklapanjem u korporativni sustav

  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Poticajno radno okruženje

  • Redovita primanja

  • Mjesečni dodatak za prehranu

  • Djelomično pokriveni troškovi prijevoza

  • Mjesečna nagrada za radne rezultate

  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci.

  • Početna plaća (tijekom probnog rada) 1.550€ BRUTO - mogućnost povećanja plaće ovisno o usvojenim znanjima, vještinama i samostalnosti u radu

  • Povećan broj dana godišnjeg odmora s obzirom na jubilarni staž i broj djece do 15 godina starosti

  • Božićnica, uskrsnica, regres, dar za djecu

  • Poklon bon za novorođenče

  • Jubilarne nagrade

  • Jasna mogućnost napredovanja kroz preuzimanje odgovornijih i kompleksnijih zadataka

  • Preuzimanje zanimljivih, izazovnih ali istovremeno zahtjevnih i odgovornih poslovnih zadataka

  • Mogućnost stjecanja novih znanja i osobnog razvoja

  • Sigurno i stabilno radno okruženja

  • Ravnotežu privatnog i poslovnog života

  • Mentorska podrška

  • Svježe voće za zaposlenike

  • Dva besplatna topla napitka dnevno po zaposleniku

  • Mogućnost punjenja električnih automobila (punionica na lokaciji)

  • Osigurana i profesionalno održavana radna odjeća (pranje i zamjena organizirani od strane poslodavca)

  • Bonus za preporuke (kada zaposlenik preporuči novog zaposlenika koji se zaposli)

POČETAK RADA I RADNO VRIJEME

  • Početak rada novih zaposlenika je 1. prosinca 2026.

  • Radi se u turnusima od 12 sati, od ponedjeljka do petka, uz rotaciju tri smjene.

MJESTO OBAVLJANJA POSLA

· Rad na proizvodnoj lokaciji u Ogulinu - Poduzetnička zona

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka u svrhu provođenja selekcijskog postupka.

POTREBNA DOKUMENTACIJA ZA PRIJAVU :

  • životopis,

  • uvjerenja da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (uvjerenje nadležnog suda ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja)

  • preslika svjedodžbe

BROJ TRAŽENIH RADNIKA : 1

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based within U.S. and Canada Eastern or Central Time. You can work from anywhere within those time zones. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

What we're looking for

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Based in U.S. or Canada Eastern or Central Time only.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $95,000—$135,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - How Linear uses Linear: How our Customer Experience team works in Linear https://linear.app/now/cx-in-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: ZÁMEČNÍK KOLEJOVÝCH VOZIDEL - PALIČ, Řezači plamenem
jobs.description: Místo výkonu práce: Dělnická č.p. 1408/29Děčín VI-Letná, 405 02  Děčín 2Jsme ryze česká, rodinná firma s více než stoletou tradicí, umíme revidovat a opravovat nákladní železniční vozy. Děláme to profesionálně, s nadšením, respektem a láskou. Máme zákazníky z celé Evropy. Dokud budou jezdit vlaky, budeme tu taky. U nás se rychle rozhodujeme, máme přehledné procesy a jasné postupy, umíme naslouchat, reagujeme na podněty, problémy řešíme. Jsme stabilní, spolehlivý a slušný zaměstnavatel. O svých více než 350 zaměstnanců se staráme, vážíme se svých lidí i lidské práce. I díky tomu rosteme, rozvíjíme se, modernizujeme a daří se nám. U nás platí podání ruky, neslibujeme, co nemůžeme splnit, jednáme na rovinu. Šikovní, ochotní a pracovití kolegové se u nás mají dobře. Topíme, svítíme, opravujeme. Práci máme nasmlouvanou na několik let dopředu, daří se nám, proto i dnes nabíráme nové kolegy. Rádi mezi nás přijmeme lidi, kteří se nebojí práce. Právě teď oslovujeme ty z vás, kteří věří, že se k nám hodí, mají rádi vlaky a bavilo by je u nás pracovat 5, 10, 15, 20 i více let. Hledáme totiž šikovné a spolehlivé zámečníky kolejových vozidel - paličce pro pracoviště Děčín.NÁPLŇ PRÁCE: Hlavní činností RYKO je provádět technickou kontrolu železničních vozů. Budete ten, kdo umí rozebrat jednotlivé části vagónu, zkontrolovat je, opravit nebo vyměnit a poté změřit. Pracujete s úhlovou bruskou, pneu nářadím, gola sadou, autogenem a pro paliče je důležitá obsluha zařízení pro plamenové řezání kyslíkem. Pracujete u nás s železničními nákladními vozy a jejich jednotlivými díly v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu od pondělí do pátku. POŽADUJEME: Vzdělání - vyučení výhodou (zámečník, mechanik, strojař, automechanik, instalatér..). Manuální zručnost. Vhodná pracovní zkušenost, zkušenost s výše uvedenými pracemi. Pečlivost, přesnost a zodpovědnost. Ochota a zájem pracovat a občas chodit na přesčasy (12 hodin/měsíc). NABÍZÍME:Několikaměsíční zaškolení a zapracování pod vedením zkušených kolegů, kteří u nás dlouhé roky pracují. Práci na nasmlouvaných zakázkách, stabilní, rodinné prostředí a lidský přístup. Práci v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu (ranní a odpolední směny), PO - PÁ, občas SO, neděle vždy volné. Termín nástupu: dohodou. MZDOVÉ PODMÍNKY: • Mzda má fixní a variabilní složku, která je závislá na výkonu, každý potřebný přesčas platíme a za nadstandartní počty přesčasových hodin jsou zvláštní bonusy• Výše nástupní mzdy dle znalostí a zkušenostní, konkrétní mzdové podmínky pro nástup, období zapracování a možnosti růstu vysvětlíme u pohovoruZAMĚSTNANECKÉ VÝHODY: • 5 týdnů dovolené• Možnost stravování v závodní jídelně s příspěvkem• Pracovní oblečení + jeho údržbu• Benefitní systém - kafetérie• Zvýhodněný telefonní tarif• Příspěvek na penzijní připojištění / životní pojištění• Náborový příspěvek 10 000 Kč Kontakt: Ing. Unser Kunde, ein etablierter und handwerklich ausgezeichneter Gipser- und Malerbetrieb in der Region Balzers, sucht Dich. Hier geht es nicht um Fliessbandarbeit. Du arbeitest an abwechslungsreichen Objekten, in einem eingespielten Team, in dem Qualität und Handschlag noch zählen. Du bist im Kern Gipser, kannst aber auch den Pinsel und die Rolle führen? B von Vorteil**Wir bieten Dir:**- Eine unbefristete Perspektive in einem stabilen, gut ausgelasteten Betrieb- Ein Handwerk mit Abwechslung: Gipsen, Verputzen und Malen statt Routine- Ein kollegiales, mehrsprachiges Team mit direkter und ehrlicher Kommunikation- Faire Anstellungsbedingungen und ein attraktives Gehalt nach Qualifikation- Moderne Maschinen und Materialien- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance, Dein Können als Allrounder auszubauen- Eine Arbeit, auf die Du am Abend stolz zurückblicken kannst

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Middle-office référentiels données de marché (H/F)
jobs.description: Je recherche aujourd'hui pour un de mes clients, basé à Guyancourt, une ou un Gestionnaire Middle-office référentiels données de marché.Vous rejoignez l'équipe Middle Office Référentiel - Market Data Administration, qui a pour vocation de gérer l'ensemble des données de marché que ce soit pour les prix (données dynamiques) ou pour les descriptions des différents instruments financiers (données statiques) : actions, obligations, futures, options listées, warrants etc. Pour cela, le Middle Référentiel utilise les flux des différents providers : Reuters, Bloomberg.et procède à un certain nombre de contrôles afin de fiabiliser ces données avant de valider leur diffusion à l'ensemble des acteurs concernés dont notamment : les Front Offices, les Middle Offices opérationnels, la Direction des Risques ainsi que les Back Offices et la Comptabilité pour l'établissement des résultats comptables. Dans ce cadre, - vous gérez le référentiel de données de marché via son processus d'acquisition-contrôle-distribution ; - vous paramétrez et maintenez les instruments dans l'ensemble des systèmes d'information de la Banque ; - vous gérez les projets au travers d'une participation de Market Data Administration à tous les projets de la Banque ayant un impact sur les données de marché.De formation spécialisée en Banque/Finance/Gestion (à partir de Bac+5), vous possédez idéalement une première expérience (stage, intérim, apprentissage, CDD.) sur un poste similaire idéalement sur du Middle-office sur les instruments financiers, sur des données de marché ou plus globalement sur les activités de marché. Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils de bureautique usuels. Un bon niveau d'anglais est indispensable du fait de l'usage quotidien dans un contexte international. Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d'analyse, votre capacité à gérer des dead lines serrées du fait de l'interaction avec les Front-offices, votre force de travail et de proposition, votre indépendance, votre esprit d'équipe. Le poste est basé à Guyancourt (78) dans un campus verdoyant qui vous réserve bien des surprises. Cette mission d'intérim s'étale sur 6 mois potentiellement renouvelable. La rémunération brute annuelle fixe est comprise entre 40 et 45 K€ selon le profil. Un modèle de travail hybride est prévu, avec minimum 2 jours par semaine de télétravail après la validation du manager. Processus : Si votre profil correspond, nous échangerons par téléphone pour faire un point sur votre parcours et votre projet professionnel. Nous validerons ensemble si le poste correspond à vos critères de recherche et les attentes du client. Si tel est le cas, nous nous rencontrerons en entretien, puis un rendez-vous sera organisé avec votre futur responsable.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for an exceptional marketing leader to drive Notion’s growth across EMEA— the team responsible for both the fuel that powers our regional go-to-market and the engine that converts it into pipeline and revenue. You'll lead a multi-disciplinary group of marketers across digital, demand, content, and campaigns, and you'll own the end-to-end system that turns regional narratives into measurable growth across markets.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team
   
   - Manage and grow a cross-functional team of marketers spanning digital, demand generation, content strategy, and campaign execution. Foster a culture of craft, speed, and accountability.

 - Own the EMEA content and campaign narrative
   
   - Develop messaging houses grounded in real customer problems, use cases, and outcomes. Build modular, deployable content bills of materials (BOMs) — stories, assets, templates, talk tracks, proof points, and examples — that travel across channels and markets.

 - Lead regional demand generation
   
   - Leadership over the EMEA demand engine—across self serve and sales assist audiences, with repeatable programmes that have clear positioning, modular assets, and measurement plans that connect directly to pipeline and revenue.

 - Orchestrate market launches and flagship campaigns
   
   - Translate global narratives into market-ready messaging, toolkits, and channel plans. Lead the content and toolkit workstream for product launches and flagship regional campaigns. Keep cross-functional plans, assets, and timelines aligned and deployable across EMEA.

 - Enable the wider regional team
   
   - Partner with Country Marketing, Storytelling, Sales, and global Product Marketing to ensure consistent storytelling, proof points, and talk tracks across every market and channel. Your team's output is what others build from.

 - Scale with AI
   
   - Build and apply AI-driven workflows to accelerate research, drafting, localisation, and asset iteration at speed — without sacrificing accuracy or customer relevance. Model this capability for the broader team.

 - Measure and sharpen
   
   - Use funnel insights — engagement data, customer feedback, and business metrics — to continuously refine messaging, content, and programmes. Report on what's working and make the case for change when it isn't.
     
      


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 12+ years in B2B marketing — with meaningful time owning both content/narrative and demand generation in a high-growth or enterprise SaaS environment.

 - Proven people leadership — experience building, managing, and developing multi-disciplinary marketing teams. You know how to hire for craft and lead through ambiguity.

 - Narrative and content mastery — you can write a compelling messaging house, build a scalable toolkit, and coach others to do the same. Customer empathy is instinctive, not a checklist item.

 - Demand generation depth — hands-on experience running and optimising paid, email, webinar, and outbound programmes, with a strong grasp of funnel metrics and revenue attribution.

 - AI fluency — you actively use AI tools to accelerate your work and can design workflows for your team to do the same. Not a curiosity — an active working practice.

 - EMEA market knowledge — experience running multi-market programmes across EMEA with an understanding of localisation needs, cultural nuance, and go-to-market variation across the region.

 - Cross-functional influence — able to align and work effectively across global and regional stakeholders in Sales, Product Marketing, Comms, and Country teams — without always having formal authority.

Dygtig og engageret sælger søges til Lilly Søndergade 70 Århus

 

Vi har fået rigtig travlt og søger, derfor en engageret sælger, der skal vejlede vores dejlige kunder i at vælge den rette kjole til deres store fest.

Så drives du af salg og god service, så se her.

 

 

Jobbet og opgaver:

Med reference til butikschefen vil din primære opgave være, at servicere og vejlede kunderne i det rette valg af brudekjole, konfirmationskjoler, festtøj og accessoires. Fokus vil være, at sikre den fortsatte vækst i butikken, uden at gå på kompromis med den gode og unikke kundeoplevelse.

 

 

Daglige arbejdsopgaver

©      Salg og rådgivning til alle kunder

©      Ansvar og indflydelse på butikkens daglige drift

©      Efterlevelse af salgs mål og fokus på mersalg

©      Optimal visuel præsentation af kollektioner

©      Planlægning og udførelse af aktiviteter/happenings i samarbejde med butikschefen

 

 

Profil og kvalifikationer:

Du er en teamplayer med et positivt og smittende humør, og kan lide en uformel omgangstone med både kunder som kolleger.

Du formår i din vejledning og rådgivning, at sætte dig ind i kundernes behov og derigennem skabe den optimale kundetilfredshed.

Vi tilbyder en spændende og udfordrende stilling, hvor du med dit engagement og motivation er med til at skabe en sjov og god arbejdsdag.

Du tilbydes gode arbejdsforhold samt løn efter kvalifikationer.

Samtaler afholdes løbende, men vi venter gerne på den rette person.

jobs.title: Directeur ou Directrice d'hôtel-restaurant (H/F)
jobs.description: Notre hôtel-restaurant, qui propose également dix salles de séminaire, recherche son directeur ou sa directrice. En collaboration directe avec la propriétaire, vous participez au fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement et à son développement commercial. Vous travaillez avec une équipe de 20 salariés répartis entre la cuisine, la salle, les étages, l'hébergement et la maintenance. Vos missions - Coordonner l'activité quotidienne : organiser les priorités et assurer la bonne circulation des informations entre les services pour garantir une prestation de qualité. - Accompagner les équipes : encadrer les collaborateurs en lien avec les responsables de service, organiser les plannings, adapter les moyens aux réservations et aux événements, contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration, à la formation et à l'évaluation des collaborateurs. - Cultiver la relation clients : être régulièrement présent à leurs côtés, comprendre leurs attentes, traiter les demandes et les réclamations et participer aux actions de communication. - Orchestrer les séminaires et événements : coordonner leur préparation et leur déroulement, de la réservation à la prestation finale, en intégrant les salles, la restauration, l'hébergement et les besoins techniques. - Développer l'activité commerciale : répondre aux demandes, construire des propositions adaptées, relancer les devis et entretenir les relations avec les entreprises et les organisateurs. - Assister la propriétaire : suivre l'activité, faire remonter les difficultés et proposer des améliorations concrètes dans votre périmètre de responsabilité. - Mesurer la satisfaction et agir : produire chaque mois un bilan comprenant la note client mensuelle, son évolution, les principaux retours et les points à améliorer. Proposer des actions concrètes et suivre leur réalisation avec les équipes. - . Coordonner leur réalisation avec les services concernés, contrôler les stocks et le matériel, analyser les écarts et anticiper les besoins de réapprovisionnement. - Donner à la propriétaire une vision claire de l'activité : organiser et suivre les inventaires, contrôler les stocks et le matériel, analyser les écarts, présenter un reporting régulier sur l'activité commerciale, la satisfaction, les inventaires et les difficultés opérationnelles, accompagné de propositions et du suivi des actions engagées. Vous aimez les gens et les échanges directs. Le contact avec les clients occupe une place centrale dans ce poste : vous prenez plaisir à accueillir, conseiller, trouver une solution et entretenir une relation dans la durée. Très organisé, vous savez anticiper, planifier et gérer plusieurs demandes simultanément. Vous restez disponible et réactif lorsque le programme change ou qu'un imprévu survient. Vous avez un véritable sens du commerce : vous écoutez les besoins, repérez les opportunités et proposez les prestations adaptées, avec le souci de la satisfaction et de la fidélisation. Vous savez fédérer des équipes aux métiers différents, donner des consignes claires et suivre leur réalisation. Votre expérience vous permet de comprendre les contraintes de l'hébergement, de la restauration et de l'accueil de groupes. Un diplôme en hôtellerie-restauration est souhaité ou une expérience pertinente et confirmée, avec des responsabilités démontrées en organisation, management et relation client. Un niveau B1 en anglais est demandé pour les échanges courants avec notre clientèle internationale.

jobs.title: CHAUFFØR søges til jordnær virksomhed
jobs.description:
CHAUFFØR søges til jordnær virksomhed

Sydsjællands Entreprenør ApS beskæftiger sig med arbejdsopgaver inden for jordarbejde, kloakarbejde, betonarbejde og belægningsarbejde.

Vi er en blanding af strukturer, rørlæggere, maskinfører og håndfolk.

Her bliver du en del af et hold, hvor den gode tone og dårlige humor ikke til at tage fejl af, men vi opfører os altid ordentlig overfor hinanden og løfter arbejdsopgaverne i flok.

Opgaverne foregår primært på Sjælland, Lolland og Falster. Der er tale om en fastansættelse med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Vi søger en dygtig chauffør, med erhvervserfaring indenfor entreprenørbranchen til kørsel med vores 4-akslet MAN lastbil med kærre og blokvogn.

Opgaver:

Arbejdet som chauffør, består i blandet kørsel inden for entreprenør- og anlægsarbejde, med bl.a. kørsel af jord, sand, grus og materialer og transport af vores maskiner. Man skal selv kunne køre og betjene diverse entreprenørmaskiner så man selv kan på og aflæsse lastbil.

 

Faglige kvalifikationer:

  • Har CE kørekort samt EU-førerbevis

  • Har takografkort

  • Har krancertifikat,

  • Kan forstå og tale dansk

 

Personlige kvalifikationer

  • Er positiv, imødekommende og serviceminded

  • Er struktureret, omhyggelig og har overblik

  • Du er kvalitetsbevidst og tager ansvar

  • Du er mødestabil

  • Er indstillet på idé- og løsningsgenerering i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kunder

 

Vi tilbyder

Som medarbejder hos Sydsjællands Entreprenør ApS får du:

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Godt arbejdsmiljø

  • En lønpakke, som afspejler dine kvalifikationer – vi har naturligvis overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

 

Kan du genkende dig selv i profilen? Så er det måske dig vi står og søger! Vores forventninger er et godt og stabilt samarbejde, hvor du vil finde dig godt til rette.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, da vi ønsker at byde dig velkommen på holdet hurtigst muligt. For spørgsmål kan du Ole Sørensen på tlf. eller mail +45 23 83 00 49/kontor@ssef.dk.

Its international operations combine technological expertise, specialised production sites and a strong understanding of customer needs.Auramo Oy is part of BOLZONI and the multinational Hyster-Yale Group. At our Järvenpää factory, we manufacture forklift attachments for the pulp, paper and forest industries.[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/a119c981-3616-4af8-9341-30cc6df400da/original.png]What will you be doing?As Quality & Environmental Manager, you will lead quality and environmental management at Auramo's Järvenpää factory. Your responsibility is to ensure that products, processes and management systems meet customer, corporate and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement across the organization.You will take ownership of quality and environmental performance, reporting and management systems, translating objectives into practical ways of working together with production and other key functions. The role includes monitoring KPI and PPM performance, leading root cause analyses and corrective actions, and turning data into meaningful improvements and business decisions.Working closely with colleagues across the factory and the wider Bolzoni Group, you will contribute to shared practices, support operational excellence and help foster a culture of structured problem-solving and continuous improvement.This is a permanent, full-time position based at Auramo's factory in Järvenpää. We hope you can start in February 2027.What are we looking for?A strong background in quality management within the manufacturing industry is essential for success in this role. A degree in mechanical engineering, production engineering or another relevant technical field will provide a solid foundation for the position.You understand quality management systems, customer requirements and industrial production processes. Experience in KPI and PPM monitoring, root cause analysis and corrective actions will help you succeed in translating data into practical improvements and informed business decisions.Experience working closely with production organisations is essential, while experience in an international environment is considered an advantage. Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills are expected, and familiarity with SAP is beneficial.Good written and spoken English is required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.In this position, you combine analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach. You are comfortable taking ownership, setting priorities and building effective cooperation across functions and stakeholders.Why join us?At Auramo, you will have a broad and influential role with the opportunity to shape quality and environmental management in a growing international business. Your work will directly impact product quality, customer satisfaction, compliance and operational performance.The position combines close-to-production responsibility with international cooperation across Bolzoni Group and Hyster-Yale. Alongside meaningful work, we offer flexible working hours, comprehensive occupational healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, and your own office.Most importantly, you'll have the freedom to apply your expertise, improve ways of working and contribute to the future development of the business.Interested?If this opportunity sounds like the right next step in your career, we would love to hear from you. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted throughout the application period.The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted
jobs.description:
Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted

Er du arbejdsom, praktisk anlagt og en holdspiller med godt humør? Og er du ikke bange for at få beskidte fingre? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Bileksport Danmark ApS søger en ny kollega til vores logistikteam på Huginsvej 6 i Ringsted.

Vi er en international virksomhed, der eksporterer omkring 100 biler om måneden. Der er fart på i hverdagen, og vi har brug for en kollega, der kan tage fat, holde overblikket og være med til at få den daglige drift til at fungere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift på vores bilplads. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

•

Modtagelse og registrering af indkommende biler

•

Flytning og organisering af biler på pladsen

•

Håndtering af bilnøgler og registreringsattester

•

Klargøring af biler til afhentning og eksport

•

Støvsugning, lettere rengøring og praktisk klargøring af biler

•

Udfyldelse af CRM-dokumenter og lettere administrative opgaver

•

Andre praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at glide

Det er en aktiv og alsidig stilling, hvor du både kommer til at bruge hænderne og hovedet. Du skal derfor trives med fysisk arbejde og være klar til at tage fat på både store og små opgaver.

Hvem er du?

Vi går mere op i din indstilling end i din uddannelse og erfaring.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du:

•

Har en stærk arbejdsmoral. Du møder til tiden, tager ansvar og gør dig umage.

•

Er en holdspiller. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og bidrager til, at vi lykkes sammen.

•

Har godt humør. Du bidrager med positiv energi, også når der er travlt.

•

Arbejder struktureret og fokuseret. Du kan holde styr på detaljerne og bevare overblikket.

•

Er praktisk anlagt. Du tager fat og er ikke for fin til at støvsuge en bil eller få beskidte fingre.

•

Har gode engelskkundskaber. Du kan kommunikere på engelsk og både tale og forstå sproget på et godt niveau.

•

Har almindelige IT-færdigheder. Du er vant til at arbejde på computer og har erfaring med eksempelvis Outlook og Excel.

•

Har almindeligt kørekort, kategori B.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra bilbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Bileksport Danmark får du en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, korte beslutningsveje og masser af personlighed.

Vi er et internationalt team med forskellige nationaliteter og baggrunde. Engelsk er en naturlig del af hverdagen og bliver blandt andet talt omkring frokostbordet.

Vi arbejder hårdt, men vi har det også sjovt.

Der er plads til humor, en uformel omgangstone og til at være den, man er. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af mennesker, der tager deres arbejde seriøst, uden nødvendigvis at tage sig selv alt for højtideligt.

Hos os får du:

•

En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

•

En aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag

•

Et internationalt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

•

Gode kollegaer og et stærkt fællesskab

•

Frihed under ansvar

•

En arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel

Praktisk information

Stilling: Pladsmedarbejder, fuldtid Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen Arbejdssted: Huginsvej 6, 4100 Ringsted Virksomhed: Bileksport Danmark ApS Kørekort: Kategori B er et krav Sprog: Gode mundtlige engelskkundskaber er et krav. Dansk er ikke nødvendigt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper@bileksportdanmark.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Bileksport Danmark ApS

jobs.title: Personalkonsult till Barona i Vasa
jobs.description: Tycker du om att arbeta med människor, skapa goda relationer och hitta lösningar? Trivs du i en varierande arbetsvardag där du får ta ansvar, arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med andra? Då kan du vara den kollega vi söker!Vi söker nu en personalkonsult till vårt team i Vasa. I rollen arbetar du främst med våra industrikunder i Österbotten och har en viktig uppgift i att sammanföra rätt människor med rätt arbetsplatser. Vi söker dig som kan kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift, och som trivs i en roll med mycket kontakt med människor.Som personalkonsult får du ett mångsidigt arbete där rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du har nära kontakt med både våra kundföretag och medarbetare och bidrar till att samarbetet fungerar smidigt från rekrytering till avslutad anställning.Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi hjälper varandra och arbetar tillsammans för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Arbetsdagarna är varierande och tempot kan tidvis vara högt, men det är också det som gör arbetet intressant.Vad innebär arbetet?Som personalkonsult är du en viktig kontaktperson för våra kundföretag, arbetssökande och uthyrda medarbetare. Du ansvarar för rekryteringsprocesser och ser till att våra medarbetare får det stöd de behöver under sin anställning.Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:- Planering och genomförande av rekryteringar från början till slut.- Utformning och publicering av platsannonser samt hantering och bedömning av ansökningar.- Intervjuer och löpande kontakt med arbetssökande.- Aktiv kontakt med våra kundföretag, uppföljning av deras personalbehov och utveckling av kundrelationerna.- Löpande kontakt och stöd till våra uthyrda medarbetare via telefon, e-post och personliga möten.- Hantering av personalrelaterade ärenden under hela anställningens livscykel.- Identifiering av nya kundbehov och samarbetsmöjligheter.Arbetet innebär många kontakter och varierande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att du kan organisera din arbetsdag, prioritera mellan olika uppgifter och ta initiativ när det behövs.Du arbetar självständigt med dina ansvarsområden, men har alltid stöd av dina kollegor och Baronas övriga experter.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med människor och har ett genuint intresse för rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer.Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt med olika människor och förstår vikten av god service och tydlig kommunikation. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förmågan att hålla ordning på flera uppgifter samtidigt.Vi uppskattar att du är initiativrik, flexibel och har en praktisk inställning till problemlösning. Vi värdesätter också din vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas i rollen.För att lyckas i rollen önskar vi att du har:- Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift.- God kommunikationsförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor.- Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att arbeta självständigt.- Goda digitala färdigheter och lätt för att lära dig nya system.- Förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt.- Ett intresse för rekrytering, HR och kundarbete.Tidigare erfarenhet av rekrytering, HR, personalservice eller kundarbete är meriterande. Även erfarenhet från industrin eller kännedom om det österbottniska näringslivet ser vi som en fördel.Eftersom vi arbetar med människor med olika språklig och kulturell bakgrund är kunskaper i engelska också värdefulla.För oss är din inställning, samarbetsförmåga och vilja att utvecklas minst lika viktiga som din tidigare erfarenhet.Vad erbjuder vi dig?Hos Barona får du ett varierande arbete med möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka hur arbetet görs. Vi erbjuder tjänster inom bland annat rekrytering, personalservice och utveckling av arbetslivet.Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett stort företag med bred kompetens och många olika verksamhetsområden, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett lokalt team med nära samarbete.Vår arbetskultur bygger på frihet, ansvar, mod och att göra saker tillsammans. Vi tror på att ge människor förtroende, uppmuntra till utveckling och hjälpa varandra att lyckas.Vill du bli vår nya kollega?Låter det här som ett arbete som skulle passa dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Skicka in din ansökan via vårt ansökningsformulär och berätta gärna lite om dig själv och varför du är intresserad av tjänsten.Vi behandlar ansökningar och träffar kandidater redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Observera att vi av datasäkerhetsskäl endast behandlar ansökningar som skickas via ansökningsformuläret, inte per e-post.Mer information om tjänsten:Kristoffer WörlundOmrådeschef och ansvarig för rekryteringen0505200200

jobs.description: Johda tiimiä, kehitä asiakkuuksia ja vaikuta tulevaisuuden tekemiseenHaluatko yhdistää ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja taloushallinnon johtamisen tehtävässä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan?
